paper.title: Routing Divergence Is Not Evidence of Behavioral Influence in Same-Weight MoE Self-Distillation
paper.abstract: Two Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) forward passes can share every weight yet route the same token through different experts. This creates a possible blind spot in same-weight self-distillation, where a demonstration-conditioned teacher supervises a query-only student. We study this mismatch in its single-step form, with frozen weights rather than as a proxy for a full training trajectory. summary.core_problem: 同权重MoE自蒸馏流程中，带演示上下文的教师前向和无演示的学生前向共享所有权重，却可能将同一个token路由到不同专家。现有MoE自蒸馏工作将路由门值的分歧直接当作蒸馏带来的行为变化的度量，但没有回答这种路由分歧实际有多大比例传导到残差流、最终影响模型输出行为。
summary.importance: 这一工作纠正了MoE训练与后训练中的一个常见误区：路由门的分歧大小不等于其对模型行为的影响大小。该结论对MoE自蒸馏、对齐训练的流程设计有直接实用价值——无需过度惩罚微小的路由漂移，只要漂移对应的残差暴露量低，就不会实质改变模型行为；反过来，过度强约束路由一致性反而会不必要地损害模型容量，这对MoE预训练中的路由正则化设计也有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: 研究限定在权重冻结、单步前向的设定下，匹配真实同权重自蒸馏的实际场景。首先推导精确的块级输出分解，将教师和学生前向在MoE块上的输出差拆为两个精确可加的项：路由不匹配项（相同隐藏状态经过不同门值产生的输出差）、类稠密内容项（隐藏状态本身偏移、在相同门值下产生的输出差，是稠密模型中也存在的内容偏移）。随后定义三个逐层逐token的度量：路由因子（路由不匹配项占MoE块输出的比例）、骨干占比（MoE块输出占残差流的比例）、残差暴露量（路由不匹配项占残差流的比例，等于路由因子乘以骨干占比），这是路由失配真正传递到后续层的有效影响量。之后在7个开源MoE检查点、两个领域上做系统性测量，通过缩放常驻共享专家的权重做干预实验验证因果关系，再通过因果A/B patching将分解的两个项和最终输出行为直接关联。
summary.experiments: 跨7个MoE检查点、两个领域的测量显示，路由不匹配项占块输出的比例波动范围仅1.6倍，但其残差暴露量的波动范围达3.2倍；暴露量与MoE块对残差的贡献占比正相关——MoE块输出占残差比例越小，路由扰动被稀释得越多。反常识的是，路由门粒度最细、最容易产生路由分歧的块，残差暴露量反而最低。在两个检查点上的骨干缩放干预验证了因果机制：常驻共享专家的权重占比越高，越能维持路由一致性，抑制路由失配的传导。因果patching结果显示，路由项的影响有界，且大部分是通用的幅度扰动，不会带来方向特异的语义偏移；类稠密的内容项才是携带方向特异性变化、主导输出行为的部分。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，重点关注分解公式的定义、路由项大小与残差暴露量的核心测量结果、骨干占比的作用、因果patching的结论，无需细看附录中的重建误差验证和量化相关鲁棒性检查，预计阅读时间20分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: In same-weight MoE self-distillation, a demonstration-conditioned teacher forward pass and demonstration-free student forward pass share all model weights, yet may route the same token to different experts. Existing MoE self-distillation work treats divergence in router gate values as a direct measure of behavioral change induced by distillation, but does not quantify how much of this routing mismatch actually propagates through the residual stream to alter final model outputs.
summary_en.importance: This work corrects a common misassumption in MoE training and post-training: the magnitude of router gate divergence does not equal the magnitude of its effect on model behavior. The finding has direct practical value for MoE self-distillation and alignment recipe design: there is no need to heavily penalize small routing drifts, as drifts with low residual exposure do not materially change model behavior. Overly strong constraints on routing consistency, by contrast, can unnecessarily reduce model capacity, a lesson also relevant for router regularization design during MoE pre-training.
summary_en.technical_approach: Analysis is performed in the frozen-weight, single-forward-pass setting that matches real same-weight self-distillation workflows. An exact blockwise output decomposition is derived, splitting output differences between teacher and student passes at each MoE block into two exactly additive terms: the routing mismatch term (output difference from applying different gate values to identical hidden states), and the dense-like content term (output difference from shifted hidden states applied to identical gates, the same type of content shift that appears in dense models). Three per-token, per-layer metrics are defined: routing factor (norm of the routing mismatch term as a share of MoE block output), backbone share (norm of MoE block output as a share of residual stream), and residual exposure (norm of the routing mismatch term as a share of residual stream, equal to routing factor multiplied by backbone share), which represents the effective magnitude of routing mismatch visible to all downstream layers. Systematic measurements are run across 7 open-weight MoE checkpoints spanning two domains, causal relationships are validated via interventions that scale the weight of always-on shared experts, and causal A/B patching is used to directly connect the two decomposed terms to final output behavior.
summary_en.experiments: Across 7 checkpoints and two domains, the routing mismatch term varies by only 1.6× as a fraction of block output, while its residual exposure varies by 3.2×. Exposure scales positively with the MoE block's contribution share to the residual: smaller MoE block contributions lead to stronger dilution of routing perturbations. Counterintuitively, blocks with the finest-grained routing (most prone to gate divergence) have among the lowest residual exposure. Backbone scaling interventions on two checkpoints confirm the causal mechanism: larger relative weight of always-on shared experts better preserves routing coherence and reduces propagation of routing mismatch. Causal patching results show the routing term has bounded effect, and produces mostly generic magnitude perturbations without direction-specific semantic shifts; the dense-like content term carries direction-specific changes that dominate output behavior.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim this paper. Focus on the decomposition definitions, core measurement results relating routing term magnitude to residual exposure, the role of backbone share, and the causal patching conclusions. Skip supplementary material on reconstruction error verification and quantization robustness checks. Estimated reading time: ~20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 对做 MoE 蒸馏/路由分析的人是个干净的反证：别把路由分歧直接当行为因果，看 §3 分解和 exposure 排序即可。
recommendation.en: A clean counter-narrative for MoE distillation work: don't equate routing divergence with behavioral influence; read the §3 decomposition and exposure ordering.

paper.title: Mitigating Rubric Interference in LLM Judges via On-Policy Self-Distillation
paper.abstract: LLM judges increasingly evaluate responses against fine-grained rubric checklists. When a sample requires multiple rubrics, current methods typically assess each in a separate inference call. Evaluating all rubrics in a single pass is a natural alternative with greater efficiency, but we find that it introduces rubric interference: the verdict on one rubric shifts depending on which other rubrics are co-present. In a preliminary study, only one-third of samples receive fully consistent verdicts

summary.core_problem: 论文处理的是多 rubric LLM judge 的一致性问题。单独评估每条 rubric 很稳定，但把多条 rubric 放在一次推理里联合评估时，同一条 rubric 的判定会被其他 rubric 的存在、顺序或噪声项影响。这会让 joint evaluation 虽然省推理成本，却引入系统性标签噪声。
summary.importance: 对预训练本身不是直接贡献，但对 post-train 和评测信号质量有实际意义。现在很多 RLHF/RLAIF、自动化 benchmark、reward model 数据生成都依赖 LLM judge。如果 judge 的细粒度 rubric 判定会因上下文组合而漂移，那么训练信号不是简单的随机噪声，而是和评测格式绑定的偏差。论文的价值在于把这个 failure mode 定义清楚，并给出一种不依赖外部标注的校正方法。
summary.technical_approach: 论文先形式化 isolation evaluation 与 joint evaluation。理想情况下，某条 rubric 的 verdict 只应依赖 conversation 和该 rubric，而不应依赖同批次出现的其他 rubrics。作者用四类受控操作测量干扰：expansion 比较单条 rubric 评估和完整 rubric 集评估；subsetting 比较嵌套 rubric 子集；reordering 检查同一组 rubric 的顺序影响；noise injection 加入来自无关样本的 rubric，测试模型是否能忽略无关评估项。指标包括 rubric-level agreement、Cohen’s kappa 和 sample-level exact match。缓解方法 SARA 是 on-policy self-distillation：学生模型先生成 joint multi-rubric evaluation，再解析成每条 rubric 的分析片段；一个慢更新 teacher 在 isolation context 下对这些片段进行评估，用作 self-anchor。训练目标包含 divergence loss，用来纠正受干扰的 reasoning/analysis；也包含 preservation loss，用来保持 verdict 结构和输出格式。它和简单 prompt engineering 或多次投票不同，核心是把 joint-mode 行为蒸馏到模型自身更稳定的 isolation-mode 判断上。
summary.experiments: 论文在三个数据集和两个模型家族上验证。一个关键现象是：在 HealthBench 上，Qwen3-32B 的 isolation verdict 与 joint verdict 只有 36% sample-level exact match；但同一设置下不同随机种子重复评估的 self-agreement 达到至少 0.98，说明问题主要不是采样随机性，而是 rubric 组合带来的系统性干扰。实验同时覆盖 binary verdict 和 scored rubric。SARA 在一致性指标上优于 base judge，并尽量保持相对 GPT-4.1 的评估质量。消融重点应看不同操作下的一致性变化，以及 rubric 数量 K 增大时干扰是否累积。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 20–30 分钟。重点看 Problem Definition 和 Table 1，那里定义了四种干扰测量操作；再看 SARA 方法部分，尤其是 joint 输出如何被解析为 per-rubric segment，以及 teacher isolation judgment 如何进入 loss。实验部分优先看 HealthBench 上 expansion/reordering/noise injection 的曲线和表格。对做 reward modeling 或 LLM-as-judge 数据管线的人，最值得深挖的是：isolation judgment 是否真的足够可靠，以及把它作为 teacher 会不会固化 judge 原有偏差。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies consistency failures in multi-rubric LLM judges. Evaluating each rubric in isolation is stable, but evaluating many rubrics in one pass can change the verdict for the same rubric depending on the other rubrics, their order, or injected irrelevant rubrics. Joint evaluation saves inference cost, but it introduces structured label noise.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining-method paper, but it matters for post-training and evaluation signal quality. LLM judges are increasingly used in benchmark scoring, reward-model data construction, and online feedback loops. If fine-grained rubric labels depend on the surrounding rubric set, the noise is not merely stochastic; it is coupled to the evaluation format. The contribution is a clear definition of this failure mode and a self-supervised mitigation path that does not require new human labels.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper formalizes isolation evaluation and joint evaluation, then tests an invariance condition: a verdict for rubric r should depend only on the conversation and r, not on the rest of the rubric set. It measures violations through four controlled operations: expansion from isolation to a larger set, subsetting between nested rubric sets, reordering of the same set, and noise injection with unrelated rubrics. Metrics include rubric-level agreement, Cohen’s kappa, and sample-level exact match. The mitigation method, SARA, uses on-policy self-distillation. A student generates a joint multi-rubric report, which is parsed into per-rubric segments. A slowly updated teacher evaluates these segments under isolation context. A divergence loss aligns analysis segments that are distorted by interference, while a preservation loss maintains verdict structure and output format. The key distinction from prompting or voting is that the method trains joint-mode behavior to match the model’s own more stable isolation-mode behavior.
summary_en.experiments: The paper evaluates on three datasets and two model families. A central result is that on HealthBench, Qwen3-32B reaches only 36% sample-level exact match between isolation and joint verdicts, while repeated evaluations under different random seeds show at least 0.98 self-agreement. This indicates a systematic context effect rather than ordinary decoding noise. The evaluation covers both binary and scored rubrics. SARA improves consistency over the base judge while preserving evaluation quality relative to GPT-4.1. The most informative ablations are the consistency curves under expansion, reordering, and noise injection, especially as the number of rubrics K increases.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. Read the problem definition and Table 1 first, since they define the four interference probes. Then read the SARA section, focusing on how joint outputs are parsed into per-rubric segments and how the isolation-context teacher supplies the training signal. In the experiments, prioritize the HealthBench expansion and reordering results. For reward-modeling or judge-based data pipelines, the main point to examine is whether isolation judgments are reliable enough to serve as anchors, and whether self-distillation may preserve existing judge biases.

recommendation.zh: 值得读干扰定义和消融；若你用 judge 产 SFT/RL 信号，single-rubric anchor 可能比省调用更值钱。
recommendation.en: Read the interference definition and ablations; if judges generate SFT/RL signals, single-rubric anchors may be worth more than saved calls.

paper.title: HPSD: Hybrid-Policy Self-Distillation for Text-Image-to-Video Diffusion Models
paper.abstract: Text-Image-to-Video (TI2V) models are an emerging unified architecture, where a single model simultaneously supports text-to-video (T2V) and image-to-video (I2V) generation. Given a high-quality first frame or a detailed textual prompt, TI2V models unlock substantially better visual quality than their T2V mode, raising a natural question: can the capability elicited by such privileged conditions be internalized into the model's own base generation ability? A common approach toward this goal is m

summary.core_problem: 让 text-image-to-video 模型在有首帧或详细文本条件下表现出的强生成能力，内化到模型自身的基础 text-to-video 生成能力中。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是多模态生成模型的后训练/自蒸馏方法。它不直接推进 LLM 预训练，但其中关于 off-policy 蒸馏、on-policy 状态分布、teacher 条件错配的讨论，对理解生成模型训练信号质量有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Hybrid-Policy Self-Distillation。论文指出直接 SFT 属于 off-policy，只学习固定离线 teacher 端点，不能纠正 student 自己访问到的状态；已有 on-policy 蒸馏又有 condition-state mismatch，即监督被首帧条件牵引而不是对齐 student 当前内容。HPSD 试图混合不同策略来源，使蒸馏信号更贴近 student 的生成轨迹，同时保留 privileged condition 的高质量监督。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型规模、训练数据、baseline 数字或提升幅度；任务范围是 TI2V 模型中的 T2V 与 I2V/TI2V 生成能力迁移，评估应围绕视频质量、条件一致性和基础 T2V 能力提升。
summary.authors_note: 作者机构包括 Shanghai Jiao Tong University、Nanyang Technological University S-Lab、University of Science and Technology of China、Fudan University、Shanghai Innovation Institute、Shanghai AI Laboratory。Jiaqi Wang 是上海人工智能实验室/OpenMMLab 相关视觉研究者。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper aims to internalize the stronger generation capability elicited by privileged text-image or first-frame conditions into a TI2V model’s base text-to-video generation mode.
summary_en.importance: This is a post-training/self-distillation method for multimodal generative models. It is not directly about LLM pretraining, but its treatment of off-policy distillation, on-policy state distributions, and supervision mismatch is relevant to training-signal quality in generative modeling.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed Hybrid-Policy Self-Distillation argues that simple SFT is off-policy because it only learns from fixed offline teacher endpoints, while prior on-policy distillation suffers from condition-state mismatch where the supervision is pulled toward the given first frame rather than the student’s actual content. HPSD mixes policy sources to align distillation with student-visited trajectories while retaining high-quality privileged-condition supervision.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide model size, training data, baseline numbers, or gain magnitudes. The evaluation is framed around transferring I2V/TI2V capability into the base T2V mode, likely using video quality and condition-alignment metrics.
summary_en.authors_note: Affiliations include Shanghai Jiao Tong University, S-Lab at Nanyang Technological University, University of Science and Technology of China, Fudan University, Shanghai Innovation Institute, and Shanghai AI Laboratory. Jiaqi Wang is a known vision researcher associated with Shanghai AI Laboratory/OpenMMLab.

recommendation.zh: 看蒸馏状态分布那部分即可；视频方法本身偏远，但 off-policy/on-policy mismatch 对 RLVR 数据有类比价值。
recommendation.en: Skim the state-distribution discussion; the video method is peripheral, but the off-policy/on-policy mismatch maps well to RLVR data design.

paper.title: Latent On-Policy Self-Distillation
paper.abstract: Enabling agents to learn from experience and internalize it into their policy has become a central problem in self-evolving AI. On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) offers an effective pathway by using a privileged self-teacher to provide dense supervision on the student's own trajectories; however, existing methods still rely heavily on designer-specified privileged artifacts (e.g., answers, feedback, skills, or trajectories), limiting the end-to-end learnability and scalability required for cont

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决 on-policy self-distillation 中 privileged context 依赖人工设计的问题。已有 OPSD 通常把答案、反馈、成功轨迹、反思文本或技能标签作为 teacher 的额外上下文，但这些格式预先规定了 teacher 能看到什么。LOPD 的目标是让 privileged context 变成可学习的连续 latent tokens，由经验数据端到端生成，并通过 teacher 的 token-level 分布监督 student。
summary.importance: 对预训练和 post-train 接口的启发在于：它把经验学习中的“监督信号形式”从人工文本模板转成可优化的 latent substrate。虽然论文场景是 agent 和 on-policy distillation，但核心问题接近 RL/SFT 数据如何转化为密集训练信号。相比 RLVR 只用稀疏可验证奖励，LOPD 试图把历史经验压缩成 teacher 可用的连续条件，使 student 在自己实际访问的状态上获得更细粒度的分布监督。这个方向对 continual self-improvement、训练信号压缩、latent memory-conditioned teacher 都有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 流程保留标准 OPSD 的结构。student 根据任务和交互历史采样自己的 trajectory；teacher 访问同一批 visited prefixes，并输出 token-level distribution；student 用 reverse-KL 向 teacher 蒸馏。关键变化是 teacher 的 privileged context 不再来自手写规则，而是由 composer 从检索到的 past experiences 中生成一组连续 latent context tokens。composer 和 student 通过同一训练目标联合优化，因此 latent context 学习保留哪些经验信息能让 teacher 给出更有用的监督。为避免 teacher 退化成容易被 student 匹配但没有额外信息的分布，作者加入 privileged-margin constraint，要求 teacher 相对 student 保持可验证的 log-probability advantage。训练结束后只保留 student，推理时不需要经验库、检索器、composer 或 latent context。
summary.experiments: 论文报告在 3 个模型 backbone 和 7 个 benchmark 上验证 LOPD。结果显示 LOPD 优于 RLVR 和代表性 OPSD 方法；相较 GRPO 和 Skill-SD，使用不到 30% 的 rollout budget 取得更好的结果。消融实验重点验证两个设计：第一，latent privileged context 需要联合学习，固定或手工设计的 context 效果较弱；第二，privileged-margin constraint 有助于保持 teacher 的信息优势，减少 teacher-student 分布塌缩。由于给出的全文片段未包含完整表格，具体 benchmark 名称和每项绝对分数无法确认。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 introduction 中对 OPSD、RLVR、privileged context 的问题定义，再看 method 中 latent composer、reverse-KL distillation 和 privileged-margin constraint 的公式。实验部分优先看三类对比：与 RLVR 的样本效率差异，与其他 OPSD 变体的对比，以及 composer / margin 的消融。预计阅读 30 分钟。如果关注 RL pretrain 或持续学习，值得重点看 latent context 是否真的学到可迁移的经验压缩，而不是只在固定 benchmark 上提供额外条件信息。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a limitation of on-policy self-distillation: the privileged context given to the self-teacher is usually hand-designed. Prior OPSD methods condition the teacher on answers, feedback, successful trajectories, textual reflections, or skill annotations. LOPD instead makes the privileged context a learnable continuous latent substrate generated from past experience.
summary_en.importance: The idea is relevant to the interface between reinforcement learning, distillation, and continual improvement. Rather than treating experience as sparse rewards or manually formatted textual artifacts, LOPD learns a compact conditioning signal that helps a self-teacher produce dense token-level supervision on the student’s own trajectories. This is a useful lens for thinking about how post-training signals can be compressed, reused, and internalized by the policy without requiring extra context at inference time.
summary_en.technical_approach: LOPD keeps the standard OPSD loop. The student samples on-policy trajectories from the task and interaction history. The teacher then reevaluates the same visited prefixes and provides token-level distributions. The student is trained with reverse-KL distillation toward the teacher. The main change is how the teacher receives privileged information: a composer retrieves prior experiences and maps them into continuous latent context tokens. The composer is optimized jointly with the distillation objective, so it learns which parts of experience are useful for teacher supervision. A privileged-margin constraint requires the teacher to maintain a verifiable log-probability advantage over the student, preventing the learned context from collapsing into an uninformative condition. At inference, only the student is kept; no retrieval module, composer, database, or latent context is needed.
summary_en.experiments: The paper reports experiments over three model backbones and seven benchmarks. LOPD outperforms RLVR and representative OPSD baselines, and achieves better results than GRPO and Skill-SD with less than 30% of their rollout budget. Ablations focus on the need to learn the privileged context jointly and the role of the privileged-margin constraint. The provided full-text excerpt does not include the complete result tables, so benchmark names and exact per-task scores cannot be verified here.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the introduction for the distinction between RLVR, OPD, and OPSD, then read the method sections covering the latent composer, reverse-KL distillation, and the privileged-margin constraint. In the experiments, prioritize comparisons against RLVR, other OPSD variants, and the ablations on composer learning and margin constraints. Expected reading time is about 30 minutes. For researchers working on RL pretraining or continual learning, the key question is whether the latent context learns a reusable compression of experience, or mainly acts as an additional benchmark-specific conditioning channel.

recommendation.zh: 把自蒸馏的特权信号从人工设计改成可学习潜在token，思路对RL-pretrain与自我进化训练有启发，重点看§3潜在token构造与训练目标设计。
recommendation.en: Replacing hand-crafted privileged signals in self-distillation with learnable latent tokens is insightful for RL-pretrain and self-evolution training; focus on §3 for latent token construction and training objectives.
