summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses how LLMs can make privacy-sensitive disclosure decisions while preserving task utility under the framework of contextual integrity, instead of relying on blunt refusal or coarse information suppression.
summary_en.importance: This is mainly a post-training objective-design contribution. It formulates the privacy-utility trade-off as self-distillation from two complementary teacher distributions and uses a PoE-style target to constrain the policy toward the intersection of capability and restraint. The main value for pretraining researchers is in the objective construction, not the model itself.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors propose SELFCI, which uses two independent reverse-KL distillation terms: one preserves task-relevant information for utility, and the other enforces minimal appropriate disclosure. The two teacher distributions are derived from feedback, and the joint objective corresponds to a Product-of-Experts target. The key idea is to decouple suppression from task resolution.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract claims improvements over existing mitigation strategies on contextual integrity settings while reducing the privacy-utility trade-off, but it does not specify model sizes, dataset scale, baselines, or exact gains. The empirical scope appears more like a focused alignment problem than a general training-law result.

recommendation.zh: 这是对齐目标的小而干净的改写，不会改变你对基座训练的 prior；若你关心 reward 设计，可只看 PoE 目标和 reverse-KL 分解，正文不必细读。
recommendation.en: This is a neat alignment-objective tweak, not something that changes pretraining priors; if reward design matters to you, just read the PoE target and the reverse-KL decomposition.

paper.title: Anti-Self-Distillation for Reasoning RL via Pointwise Mutual Information
paper.abstract: On-policy self-distillation, where a student is pulled toward a copy of itself conditioned on privileged context (e.g., a verified solution or feedback), offers a promising direction for advancing reasoning capability without a stronger external teacher. Yet in math reasoning the gains are inconsistent, even when the same approach succeeds elsewhere. A pointwise mutual information analysis traces the failure to the privileged context itself: it inflates the teacher's confidence on tokens already

summary.core_problem: 研究数学推理 RL 中 on-policy self-distillation 增益不稳定的问题，尤其是带 privileged context 的教师分布为何会压制有效的多步探索 token。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是后训练方法与训练信号分析。它把 self-distillation 的失败解释落到逐 token 的 PMI 结构上：教师在答案结构和可验证声明上变得更自信，却在“Wait / Let / Maybe”这类探索性 deliberation token 上降低概率。这对推理 RL 的 token-level reward shaping 有直接参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Anti-Self-Distillation。常规 self-distillation 是让 student 下降到 privileged-context teacher 的分布；AntiSD 反过来上升 student 与 teacher 的 divergence，把逐 token 符号翻转，形成一步内有界的 advantage。方法还加入 entropy-triggered gate：当 teacher entropy 已经塌缩时关闭该项，避免继续放大退化信号。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出完整实验配置、模型规模、数据集和提升幅度。可确认的是目标场景为数学推理 RL，并声称 AntiSD 是默认 self-distillation 项的 drop-in replacement，用于改善原方法在数学任务上的不稳定收益。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies why on-policy self-distillation with privileged context gives inconsistent gains in mathematical reasoning RL, especially when the teacher distribution suppresses tokens needed for multi-step search.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a post-training method plus a token-level signal analysis. The PMI view argues that privileged context makes the teacher overconfident on structurally implied or verifiable tokens while reducing probability on deliberative tokens such as “Wait,” “Let,” and “Maybe.” This is directly relevant to reward shaping and distillation signals for reasoning models.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed method, Anti-Self-Distillation, reverses the usual distillation direction: instead of descending the divergence between student and privileged teacher, it ascends it. This flips the per-token sign and yields a bounded one-step advantage. An entropy-triggered gate disables the term once teacher entropy collapses, preventing the method from amplifying a degenerate teacher signal.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide full experimental details, model sizes, datasets, or exact gains. The reported setting is mathematical reasoning RL, and AntiSD is positioned as a drop-in replacement for the standard self-distillation term.

recommendation.zh: 只看 PMI 分解和 entropy gate；若 token-level 图干净，值得在内部 RLVR 蒸馏项里复现。
recommendation.en: Read the PMI decomposition and entropy gate; if the token-level plots are clean, this is worth reproducing inside RLVR distillation losses.

paper.title: Reducing the Safety Tax in LLM Safety Alignment with On-Policy Self-Distillation
paper.abstract: Safety alignment often improves robustness to harmful queries at the cost of reasoning ability, a tradeoff known as the safety tax. A common cause is distributional mismatch: supervised fine-tuning trains the target model on safety demonstrations produced by humans, external models, or fixed self-generated traces, rather than on trajectories sampled from its own policy. We identify off-policy training mismatch as a second source of this tax and study on-policy self-distillation for safety alignm

summary.core_problem: LLM安全对齐中普遍存在安全税问题：提升模型对有害查询的鲁棒性通常会牺牲通用推理能力。除了已被广泛讨论的训练数据分布不匹配（使用外部人类或模型生成的离分布演示）之外，现有SFT对齐方法的off-policy属性会带来第二类不匹配：监督信号作用于固定的演示轨迹而非模型自身采样的轨迹，导致梯度分散在整个回复序列中，无法精准控制决定安全行为的早期token窗口，最终既扰动了通用推理能力，也无法提供细粒度的安全决策监督。
summary.importance: 从训练范式层面解释了安全税的第二类成因，将on-policy自蒸馏引入安全对齐领域，为降低安全与推理的 tradeoff 提供了新的方法路径；token级监督的设计思路也可以迁移到预训练后对齐阶段的能力保护，减少对齐对基座模型核心能力的损伤。
summary.technical_approach: 提出OPSA（On-Policy Self-Distillation for Safety Alignment）框架，核心是对模型自身采样的on-policy轨迹施加token级的KL监督：首先冻结待对齐的基座模型作为教师，通过特权上下文激活教师的安全行为——有害查询对应的特权上下文引导教师输出拒绝行为，良性查询对应的特权上下文保留教师的正常回复行为。为了筛选有效的特权上下文，引入无需训练的教师翻转率（TFR）指标，衡量特定上下文将有害回复转换为安全回复的比例，选择高TFR的上下文作为教师的条件输入。训练过程中，学生模型（待对齐的活跃参数副本）采样自身的回复轨迹，对每个token计算与条件教师输出的KL散度作为损失，从而将梯度集中在安全决策的早期关键窗口，无需强制整个序列匹配固定演示。
summary.experiments: 在5个不同规模的模型上进行实验，OPSA在安全与推理的tradeoff上优于所有off-policy训练基线，且对自适应越狱攻击的鲁棒性更强，说明方法没有过拟合到标准拒绝基准；同时OPSA对训练数据规模的敏感度低于SFT，在不同数据量下都能保持更优的对齐效果。具体的性能提升幅度未在已提供的论文片段中完整呈现。
summary.reading_guide: 重点阅读第3节的token级分析部分，理解off-policy SFT的梯度分散问题和OPSA的监督机制差异；第4节的特权上下文构建和教师翻转率的设计细节；泛读实验部分的tradeoff对比结果，全文预计阅读时间1-1.5小时。
summary.authors_note: 论文未提供完整作者和机构信息

summary_en.core_problem: LLM safety alignment universally faces the safety tax: improving robustness to harmful queries typically degrades general reasoning ability. Beyond the widely discussed training data distribution mismatch (using out-of-distribution demonstrations from humans or external models), the off-policy nature of existing SFT alignment methods introduces a second source of mismatch: supervision signals are applied to fixed demonstration trajectories instead of the model's own sampled trajectories. This causes gradients to spread across the entire response sequence, failing to precisely control the early token window that determines safety behavior, ultimately perturbing general reasoning while providing only coarse supervision for safety-critical decisions.
summary_en.importance: It explains the second cause of safety tax from the training paradigm perspective, introduces on-policy self-distillation to the safety alignment domain, and provides a new approach to reduce the safety-reasoning tradeoff. The token-level supervision design can also be extended to protect core capabilities during post-pretrain alignment, minimizing alignment damage to base model performance.
summary_en.technical_approach: The OPSA (On-Policy Self-Distillation for Safety Alignment) framework is proposed, with the core of applying token-level KL supervision to the model's own on-policy sampled trajectories. First, the base model to be aligned is frozen as the teacher, and privileged contexts are used to activate the teacher's safety behavior: privileged contexts for harmful queries steer the teacher toward refusal behavior, while privileged contexts for benign queries preserve the teacher's normal response behavior. To select effective privileged contexts, the training-free Teacher Flip Rate (TFR) metric is introduced, measuring the proportion of unsafe responses converted to safe ones by a specific context. Contexts with high TFR are selected as conditional inputs for the teacher. During training, the student model (active parameter copy of the model being aligned) samples its own response trajectories, and the KL divergence between each token output and the conditional teacher output is used as loss. This concentrates gradients on the early critical window of safety decisions without forcing the entire sequence to match a fixed demonstration.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments across 5 models of different sizes show OPSA achieves a better safety-reasoning tradeoff than all off-policy training baselines, with higher robustness against adaptive jailbreak attacks, indicating no overfitting to standard refusal benchmarks. OPSA is also less sensitive to training set size than SFT, maintaining superior alignment performance across different data scales. Full specific performance improvement metrics are not included in the provided paper excerpts.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 3 for token-level analysis, understanding the gradient diffusion problem of off-policy SFT and the difference in supervision mechanisms with OPSA. Read Section 4 for details of privileged context construction and Teacher Flip Rate design. Skim experimental results for tradeoff comparisons. Estimated reading time is 1-1.5 hours.
summary_en.authors_note: Full author and affiliation information is not provided in the paper excerpts

recommendation.zh: 将安全税归因于 off-policy mismatch，并用带 privileged context 的 on-policy KL 蒸馏来解，思路干净，值得看其 context 搜索和 KL 监督细节。
recommendation.en: Attributes the safety tax to off-policy mismatch and solves it with on-policy KL distillation using a privileged context. The approach is clean; worth reading the context search and KL supervision details.

paper.title: Self-Distilled Agentic Reinforcement Learning
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) has emerged as a central paradigm for post-training LLM agents, yet its trajectory-level reward signal provides only coarse supervision for long-horizon interaction. On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD) complements RL by introducing dense token-level guidance from a teacher branch augmented with privileged context. However, transferring OPSD to multi-turn agents proves problematic: compounding multi-turn instability destabilizes supervision, while skill-conditioned priv

summary.core_problem: 多轮 Agent 的 RL 训练只有轨迹级奖励，监督很稀疏；直接叠加 on-policy self-distillation 又会因为师生轨迹漂移和检索技能质量不稳定，产生逐轮放大的 token 级错误监督。
summary.importance: 这是一篇 post-train 方法论文，但对预训练研究有两个启发。第一，长程交互里的 token 级监督不能简单看成更密的 reward，它会随上下文分布漂移而失真。第二，带 privileged context 的 teacher 不是绝对更强模型，它的正向 endorsement 和负向 rejection 可信度不对称。这对 RL pretrain、tool-use pretrain、agentic continual training 都有参考价值：辅助目标要保护主优化目标的语义，不能把不稳定的 token 偏好直接混进 advantage。
summary.technical_approach: SDAR 把 RL 保持为主干优化目标，把 OPSD 只作为 gated auxiliary loss。它没有像 RLSD 那样用 teacher-student divergence 去重加权 RL advantage，因为这会改变 advantage 的含义，并可能在训练早期放大错误更新。它选择保留 verifier-driven RL loss 的形式，同时在 token 级别控制蒸馏强度。核心设计有两点：一是 asymmetric privileged guidance，只更信任 teacher 对 student 已采样 token 的正向提升信号，即 teacher 概率高于 student 的 token；对 teacher 概率更低的 negative-gap token 更保守，因为这类信号可能来自错误检索、技能未被 teacher 正确利用，或多轮轨迹漂移。二是 adaptive smooth gating，用 student entropy、teacher-student divergence 等 token 级信号决定蒸馏门控，而不是按固定轮数、固定深度或人工 curriculum 开关蒸馏。训练时 teacher branch 使用训练期可见的技能或参考上下文，student 在测试时不依赖这些 privileged context。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 Qwen2.5 与 Qwen3 系列，在 ALFWorld、WebShop、Search-QA 三类 Agent benchmark 上验证。文中报告 7B 模型相对 GRPO 在 ALFWorld 提升 9.4%，Search-QA 提升 7.0%，WebShop-Acc 提升 10.2%。SDAR 避免了 naïve GRPO+OPSD 的性能崩溃，并在 Qwen3-1.7B 等不同规模上超过 Skill-SD、RLSD 等 RL-OPSD 混合方法。消融重点在多轮 KL 漂移、negative-gap token 占比、门控信号选择和检索质量鲁棒性。一个有信息量的结果是：即使使用 random retrieval，SDAR 仍能超过 GRPO baseline，说明门控机制确实过滤了一部分低质量技能噪声，而不是单纯依赖检索器质量。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 25 分钟。先看 Introduction 中 Figure 2 和 Figure 3，理解 multi-turn OPSD instability、teacher-student KL 逐轮上升、negative-gap token 超过 50% 这些现象。再看 Method 里的 gated auxiliary OPSD loss、positive/negative gap 的处理方式，以及门控函数如何由 entropy 或 divergence 驱动。实验部分重点看与 GRPO、GRPO+OPSD、RLSD、Skill-SD 的对比，以及 retrieval quality ablation。若关注 RL pretrain，可重点思考一个问题：哪些 token 级辅助信号可以安全地作为 loss，哪些不应直接改写 RL advantage。

summary_en.core_problem: Multi-turn agent RL receives sparse trajectory-level rewards, while naive on-policy self-distillation can become unstable because teacher-student trajectories drift and skill-conditioned privileged context is not always reliable.
summary_en.importance: The main value is not a new base pretraining recipe, but a useful training principle for agentic post-training and RL-style pretraining. Dense token supervision is not automatically better than sparse reward in long-horizon interaction. Once the context distribution drifts, token-level guidance can become wrong at scale. The work also makes a concrete distinction between positive teacher endorsements and negative teacher rejections when the teacher is only the same policy augmented with training-only context, not an independently stronger model.
summary_en.technical_approach: SDAR keeps RL as the primary objective and adds OPSD as a gated auxiliary loss. It does not reweight RL advantages with teacher-student divergence, because that can change the semantics of the advantage and amplify early mismatches. The teacher branch has privileged context, such as retrieved skills, while the student follows the normal test-time context. Distillation is applied selectively at token level. If the teacher assigns a higher probability to a sampled student token, the signal is treated as a relatively trustworthy endorsement. If the teacher assigns a lower probability, the signal is handled conservatively, since it may reflect poor retrieval, poor skill utilization, or accumulated multi-turn drift. The gate is smooth and adaptive, using token-level statistics such as student entropy or teacher-student divergence instead of a fixed curriculum over turns or trajectory depth.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation uses Qwen2.5 and Qwen3 model families on ALFWorld, WebShop, and Search-QA. For the 7B setting, the reported gains over GRPO are 9.4% on ALFWorld, 7.0% on Search-QA, and 10.2% on WebShop-Acc. Naive GRPO plus OPSD shows catastrophic instability, while SDAR avoids this failure mode and consistently improves over hybrid baselines such as Skill-SD and RLSD, including smaller Qwen3-1.7B runs. The robustness study varies skill retrieval quality. A notable result is that even random retrieval can outperform the GRPO baseline under SDAR, suggesting that token-level gating removes part of the noise from low-quality privileged context.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 25-minute skim is enough for most readers. Start with Figures 2 and 3 to see the empirical failure mode: KL growth across turns, teacher-student drift, and the large fraction of negative-gap tokens. Then read the method details for the gated OPSD auxiliary objective and the asymmetric treatment of positive versus negative teacher signals. In the experiments, focus on comparisons against GRPO, naive GRPO+OPSD, RLSD, and Skill-SD, plus the retrieval-quality ablation. The useful question to carry over to RL pretraining is which token-level signals should remain auxiliary losses and which ones are too unstable to be folded into the policy advantage.

recommendation.zh: 做Agent RL后训练可参考§4的门控设计，其他方向无需深入阅读。
recommendation.en: Reference the gating design in §4 if working on agent RL post-training, otherwise no in-depth reading needed.

paper.title: Learning from Language Feedback via Variational Policy Distillation
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards (RLVR) suffers from sparse outcome signals, creating severe exploration bottlenecks on complex reasoning tasks. Recent on-policy self-distillation methods attempt to address this by utilizing language feedback to generate dense, token-level supervision. However, these approaches rely on a fixed, passive teacher to interpret the feedback. As the student policy improves, the teacher's zero-shot assessment capabilities plateau, ultimately halting furth

summary.core_problem: 现有基于语言反馈的在策略自蒸馏方法使用固定的被动教师模型解读反馈，随着学生模型能力提升，教师的零样本评估能力进入瓶颈，无法提供更精细的梯度信号，导致学习停滞；同时标准RLVR依赖稀疏的二元结果奖励，存在严重的信用分配和探索瓶颈。
summary.importance: 对RL pretrain和后训练的反馈利用有方法参考价值，提出了教师和学生协同进化的自蒸馏框架，明确了语言反馈驱动自蒸馏的适用边界。
summary.technical_approach: 提出变分策略蒸馏（VPD）框架，将从语言反馈学习形式化为变分期望最大化（EM）问题：E步基于轨迹结果和语言反馈主动优化教师模型的反馈解读能力，M步将优化后的教师的token级知识蒸馏到学生策略中；两者共享权重，通过自适应信任区域保证训练稳定性。
summary.experiments: 在编程、科学推理等基准上，VPD效果优于标准RLVR和现有被动自蒸馏基线；实验同时发现，虽然VPD能有效缓解训练崩溃、延迟性能平台期，但在任务难度极高的冷启动场景下，纯稀疏奖励RL最终仍是更有效的范式。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读引言了解现有自蒸馏方法的核心缺陷，第3章看EM框架的形式化推导，第4章看核心实验和适用边界分析；预计阅读时间20分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing on-policy self-distillation methods using language feedback rely on a fixed, passive teacher to interpret feedback. As student policy improves, the teacher's zero-shot evaluation capability plateaus and can no longer provide fine-grained gradient signals, leading to training stagnation. Additionally, standard RLVR depends on sparse binary outcome rewards, with severe credit assignment and exploration bottlenecks.
summary_en.importance: Offers methodological reference for RL pretraining and post-training feedback utilization, proposes a co-evolution framework for teacher and student policies, and clarifies the applicable boundary of language feedback-driven self-distillation.
summary_en.technical_approach: The Variational Policy Distillation (VPD) framework formalizes learning from language feedback as a variational Expectation-Maximization (EM) problem. In the E-step, the teacher model is actively optimized to interpret language feedback based on trajectory outcomes. In the M-step, token-level knowledge from the refined teacher is distilled into the student policy. The two models share weights, and an adaptive trust region ensures training stability.
summary_en.experiments: On programming and scientific reasoning benchmarks, VPD outperforms standard RLVR and existing passive self-distillation baselines. Experiments also show that while VPD effectively mitigates training collapse and delays performance plateaus, pure sparse-reward RL remains the more effective paradigm in extremely hard cold-start scenarios.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the introduction to understand core limitations of existing self-distillation methods, read Section 3 for formal derivation of the EM framework, and review Section 4 for core experimental results and applicability boundary analysis; estimated reading time: 20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 将语言反馈转化为 token 级密集监督的 EM 框架，对解决 RLVR 稀疏奖励有启发，关注其 E 步教师模型动态更新的具体实现。
recommendation.en: An EM framework converting language feedback into dense token-level supervision; inspiring for RLVR sparse reward issues. Focus on the dynamic teacher update in the E-step.

paper.title: Respecting Self-Uncertainty in On-Policy Self-Distillation for Efficient LLM Reasoning
paper.abstract: On-policy self-distillation trains a reasoning model on its own rollouts while a teacher, often the same model conditioned on privileged context, provides dense token-level supervision. Existing objectives typically weight the teacher's token-level signal uniformly across a chain-of-thought sequence, despite substantial variation in the entropy of the teacher's predictive distribution. We propose EGRSD (Entropy-Guided Reinforced Self-Distillation), which unifies token-level updates through three

summary.core_problem: 在 on-policy 自蒸馏（Self-Distillation）训练推理模型时，教师模型提供的 token 级别监督信号可靠性存在巨大差异（有些是确定性计算，有些是高熵的分支点），均匀赋予权重会导致模型过度拟合高方差的监督信号。
summary.importance: 为 on-policy 自蒸馏引入了“教师预测熵”作为第三种监督信号（与奖励方向和教师-学生似然比并列），提供了一种更精细、更稳定的 token 级别权重分配机制，有助于在保持推理准确率的同时减少冗余计算。
summary.technical_approach: 提出了 EGRSD（Entropy-Guided Reinforced Self-Distillation）。核心机制是计算特权教师（privileged teacher）在每个 token 处的预测熵，并用其构建一个置信度门控（confidence gate）。低熵的确定性 token 获得近乎全额的权重，而高熵的分支 token 权重被衰减，但保留一个非零下界以避免丢失有效的分支多样性。进一步提出了 CL-EGRSD，引入因果前瞻（causal-lookahead）窗口，以区分持续的高熵片段和短暂的策略转换点（pivots），从而保留后者带来的关键转换信号。
summary.experiments: 在 Qwen3-4B 和 Qwen3-8B 上进行了验证。结果表明，置信度门控更新在准确率-长度权衡（accuracy-length frontier）上优于其他可训练方法。消融实验显示，适度的熵衰减能带来最稳定的性能；前瞻机制（lookahead）在更大模型（8B）上效果更明显，因为大模型更容易利用策略转换点。
summary.reading_guide: 建议重点阅读 Section 4.2 中 EGRSD 的置信度门控公式设计，以及 CL-EGRSD 如何通过前瞻窗口处理瞬态高熵 token。实验部分关注图 1 中的准确率-长度权衡曲线，以及消融实验中对不同熵衰减程度的分析。

summary_en.core_problem: In on-policy self-distillation for reasoning models, the reliability of token-level supervision from the teacher model varies significantly (e.g., deterministic computation vs. high-entropy branching points). Uniformly weighting these signals can lead to overfitting on high-variance supervision.
summary_en.importance: Introduces 'teacher predictive entropy' as a third supervision signal (alongside reward direction and teacher-student likelihood ratio) in on-policy self-distillation. This provides a more granular and stable token-level weighting mechanism, helping to reduce redundant computation while maintaining reasoning accuracy.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes EGRSD (Entropy-Guided Reinforced Self-Distillation). The core mechanism computes the privileged teacher's predictive entropy at each token to construct a confidence gate. Low-entropy deterministic tokens receive near-full weight, while high-entropy branching tokens are attenuated but retain a non-zero lower bound to preserve valid branching diversity. Further proposes CL-EGRSD, which introduces a causal-lookahead window to distinguish sustained high-entropy spans from transient strategy-shift pivots, thereby preserving the critical transition signals carried by the latter.
summary_en.experiments: Validated on Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B. Results show that the confidence-gated update advances the accuracy-length frontier compared to other trainable methods. Ablations indicate that moderate entropy attenuation yields the most stable performance, and the lookahead mechanism is more effective on the larger model (8B), which can better exploit strategy pivots.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 4.2 for the formulation of the confidence gate in EGRSD, and how CL-EGRSD handles transient high-entropy tokens via the lookahead window. In the experiments, pay attention to the accuracy-length trade-off curves in Figure 1 and the ablation studies on different degrees of entropy attenuation.

recommendation.zh: 值得看目标函数而非榜单；§方法里 entropy gate 可直接变成内部 CoT 蒸馏 ablation。
recommendation.en: Read the objective, not the leaderboard; the entropy gate is a clean ablation to try in internal CoT distillation.

paper.title: Learning with Rare Success but Rich Feedback via Reflection-Enhanced Self-Distillation
paper.abstract: Enabling Large Language Models (LLMs) to continuously improve from environmental interactions is a central challenge in post-training. While on-policy self-distillation offers a promising paradigm, existing methods predominantly treat environmental feedback as a passive conditioning signal. Consequently, they heavily rely on successful demonstrations and struggle to learn in rare-success regimes. To bridge this gap, we introduce Reflection-Enhanced Self-Distillation (RESD), a framework that tran

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是一个很具体、也很棘手的 post-train 学习问题：当环境奖励极稀疏、成功轨迹几乎拿不到，但环境又能返回较丰富的执行反馈时，模型怎样从失败中稳定起步。已有 on-policy self-distillation，如 SDPO/OPSD，已经把轨迹级稀疏奖励改写成 token 级蒸馏信号，但它们通常只是把环境反馈原样拼到 teacher prompt 里，默认模型自己会从这些原始错误信息中提炼出可学习的修正信号。作者指出，真正的瓶颈不只是有没有反馈，而是反馈是否被组织成可迁移、可复用、可监督的形式。尤其在 rare-success regime 下，teacher 几乎只能依赖失败轨迹来给 student 提供监督；如果失败反馈只是未结构化日志、报错信息或 binary outcome，teacher 给出的 token 分布改进会很弱，学生也很难靠单次 rollout 自举起来。
summary.importance: 它对预训练本身不是直接方法贡献，更接近 pretrain↔post-train 接口上的一个信号工程问题：如何把环境交互中的弱信号转成更密、更稳定的学习目标。启发点有两层。第一，self-distillation 的效果高度依赖“反馈表示”，而不是只依赖蒸馏目标形式；这和预训练里数据格式、标注结构、target design 影响训练动态是同一类问题。第二，它提示一种比纯 RL 更样本节省的 bootstrapping 路径：先把失败经验转成局部纠错知识，再用蒸馏把这些知识压回基础策略；等成功率起来后，再让 reward-based optimization 接管。这种分阶段思路，对持续学习、在线 mid-train、agentic post-train 都有参考价值。贡献量级上，它更像一个实用而清晰的训练框架改造，不是新理论范式，但在“稀疏成功 + 丰富反馈”的设置里有明确增益。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是 Reflection-Enhanced Self-Distillation（Resd）。整体仍沿用 on-policy self-distillation 框架：当前策略 πθ 采样轨迹，旧策略或滑动平均策略 πθ_old 作为 self-teacher，在更“特权”的上下文下输出每一步 token 分布，student 去拟合 teacher 的分布。训练目标写成统一的 f-divergence 形式，兼容 forward KL、reverse KL、JSD 等，并对 likelihood ratio 做 clipping 来稳住训练。

Resd 的新增部分不在 loss，而在 teacher context 的构造。它做了两层增强：
1. retrospective reflection：对每条失败轨迹，额外生成一段回顾式反思，内容不是泛泛总结，而是定位局部错误、解释为什么失败、指出如果当时做什么会更好。这样 teacher 在重看同一轨迹时，不再只看到原始环境反馈，而是看到一份已经被语言化、因果化、局部化的纠错说明。
2. persistent global playbook：把训练过程中反复出现、可复用的经验教训沉淀成一个持续更新的“手册”。后续 teacher prompt 不只带当前轨迹的 reflection，还会带上相关 playbook 条目。这样监督信号不再局限于单条 rollout，而是能跨 step 复用失败中提炼出的策略知识。

这两点合起来，等于把环境反馈从 passive conditioning 变成 active supervision。和标准 SDPO/OPSD 的区别，不是 teacher 更强，也不是引入外部 oracle，而是先对失败反馈做解释层加工，再让 self-teacher 在这个 enriched context 下重估 token 分布。作者还强调该模块是 plug-and-play 的，原则上可接到不同 self-distillation objective 上。

从机制上看，这个设计为什么可能有效：raw feedback 往往是结果级、全局级、低带宽的；reflection 把它变成局部决策层面的错误归因，playbook 再把一次性经验变成跨样本先验。对于 token-level distillation，这种结构化上下文更容易改变 teacher 在关键决策点的条件分布，而不是只在结尾处给出模糊惩罚。
summary.experiments:
实验重点不是大规模通用 benchmark，而是在线流式学习协议下的持续改进能力。任务被刻意设计成：对模型较新、初始成功率低、但环境能返回较丰富执行反馈。作者关心的是 rare-success 初期能否靠失败自举，而不是高成功率阶段的最终上限。

主要结果层面，Resd 相比标准 self-distillation baseline 有稳定提升，尤其在早期学习阶段更明显；和 GRPO 相比，在只用单次 rollout per prompt 的条件下，Resd 的起步速度更快。这一点很关键，因为它说明结构化反馈可以在成功样本几乎没有时先把策略推离随机探索区，而纯 reward optimization 往往要等到足够多成功轨迹出现后才开始有效。

从文中描述看，作者还做了若干对照：
- 直接拼接原始失败反馈 vs. 加 reflection：前者改进有限，后者能显著增强 teacher supervision。
- 只有局部 reflection vs. reflection + global playbook：playbook 带来跨 step 的知识保留，减少每次都从头解释失败。
- 与 reward-based 方法比较：Resd 在 sample efficiency 和 early-stage bootstrap 上更占优，但作者并没有宣称替代 RL，而是把 RL 视为成功率上升后的互补优化器。

给出的全文片段没有完整表格数字、参数量和数据规模细节，因此无法可靠填入具体百分点、模型大小或 token 数。能确认的是，实验协议强调 online streaming、single-rollout setting，以及在 sparse binary reward 之外利用 rich execution feedback。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读时先抓三处。

第一，看 Introduction 和 Figure 1。这里把问题界定得很清楚：不是 self-distillation 无效，而是 raw failure feedback 的表示太弱。Figure 1 应该是理解作者动机的关键图。

第二，看方法部分里 teacher context 的构造流程。重点不是 f-divergence 公式本身，而是 reflection 如何生成、playbook 如何维护、它们怎样进入 teacher prompt。这里决定了方法到底是在“做更好的提示工程”，还是在“做可持续的监督信号重写”。

第三，看实验中的 early-stage curves 和 ablation。优先关注 rare-success 初期、single-rollout 条件下的学习曲线，以及 raw feedback / reflection / playbook 三者的拆分对比。这些结果最能说明方法是否真的在从失败中学习，而不是只是在成功样本出现后放大收益。

如果时间有限，预计 20–30 分钟可以完成泛读：读引言、方法总览、两三个核心实验图表即可。若想判断它对 continual pretrain 或 online post-train 是否有迁移价值，再补 appendix 里关于 f-divergence 选择和训练稳定性的说明。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a specific failure mode in online post-training: how to improve from interaction when successful trajectories are extremely rare, yet the environment provides rich execution feedback. Existing on-policy self-distillation methods such as SDPO/OPSD already replace sparse trajectory rewards with token-level supervision from a self-teacher, but they mostly treat environment feedback as a passive prompt attachment. That works poorly in rare-success regimes, because the teacher has to infer corrective supervision almost entirely from failed rollouts. If the feedback remains as raw logs, error strings, or binary outcomes, the resulting teacher distribution is only weakly improved, and the student cannot bootstrap effectively.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining paper in the narrow sense, but it is relevant to the pretrain–post-train interface because it studies how weak interaction signals can be converted into denser and more reusable learning targets. Two points matter. First, the effectiveness of self-distillation depends heavily on feedback representation, not just on the divergence objective. That is closely related to target design and data formatting issues in pretraining. Second, it suggests a practical bootstrapping recipe for sparse-reward settings: first turn failures into localized corrective knowledge, distill that knowledge back into the base policy, and only rely more on reward optimization once success becomes frequent enough. The contribution is best read as a clean training-framework improvement rather than a new learning paradigm, but it addresses a real bottleneck in rare-success online learning.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method, Reflection-Enhanced Self-Distillation (Resd), keeps the standard on-policy self-distillation backbone. The current policy πθ samples trajectories. A self-teacher, instantiated from older or moving-average weights πθ_old, is given privileged context and produces token distributions for the same trajectory. The student then matches the teacher distribution with a unified f-divergence objective, with clipped likelihood ratios for stability. The loss family can recover forward KL, reverse KL, JSD, and related variants.

The main change is not in the loss but in how the teacher context is constructed. Resd adds two layers of structure:
1. Retrospective reflection. For each failed rollout, the system generates a reflection that diagnoses likely local mistakes, explains why the trajectory failed, and states what correction would have helped. This converts raw failure feedback into a more explicit error-attribution signal.
2. Persistent global playbook. Recurrent lessons extracted from failures are stored in a reusable playbook that persists across training steps. Future teacher prompts can condition not only on the current trajectory and its reflection, but also on accumulated reusable lessons.

This changes feedback from passive conditioning into active corrective supervision. Compared with standard SDPO/OPSD, the novelty is not a stronger external teacher and not a different policy class. The novelty is an intermediate interpretation layer that rewrites failure feedback into a form that can more directly alter the teacher’s token-level posterior.

Mechanistically, the design is sensible. Raw environment feedback is often global, low-bandwidth, and outcome-level. Reflection turns it into localized causal guidance. The playbook then amortizes that guidance across future examples. For token-level distillation, this should matter because the teacher can shift probability mass at the actual decision points that caused failure, rather than merely seeing a vague end-of-trajectory penalty.
summary_en.experiments:
The evaluation focuses on online continual-improvement settings rather than static offline benchmarks. Tasks are chosen to be relatively novel to the model, to start in a rare-success regime, and to provide rich execution feedback despite sparse binary rewards. The central question is whether the method can bootstrap from failures before successful demonstrations become common.

The main empirical finding is that Resd consistently outperforms standard self-distillation baselines, with the largest gains appearing in the early learning phase. Relative to GRPO, Resd improves faster at the beginning while using only a single rollout per prompt. That result is important because it supports the paper’s main claim: structured feedback can move the policy out of the pure-exploration regime even when successful trajectories are nearly absent, whereas reward-based optimization often becomes effective only after enough successes appear.

The paper also appears to include the key ablations one would want:
- raw failure feedback versus reflection-enhanced feedback;
- local reflection alone versus reflection plus a persistent playbook;
- comparison against reward-based optimization.
These comparisons support the interpretation that the gains come from better supervision extraction from failures, not from a stronger teacher or more rollouts.

The provided full-text excerpt does not include the complete result tables, parameter counts, or exact dataset/task sizes, so I cannot reliably state concrete model scales or percentage improvements. What is clear is the protocol emphasis: online streaming training, single-rollout supervision, sparse binary reward, and rich execution feedback.
summary_en.reading_guide:
For a quick read, focus on three parts.

First, read the introduction and inspect Figure 1 carefully. That is where the paper makes its strongest conceptual point: the bottleneck is not self-distillation per se, but the weak structure of raw failure feedback.

Second, in the method section, spend time on how reflections are generated, how the playbook is maintained, and how both are inserted into the teacher context. That is the actual contribution. The f-divergence formulation is useful but not the main reason to read the paper.

Third, look at the early-stage learning curves and the ablations. The most informative evidence is whether the method helps in the rare-success phase under a single-rollout budget, and whether reflection and playbook each contribute separately.

A practical skim should take around 20–30 minutes: introduction, method overview, and the main experimental figures. If you want to assess transfer to continual pretraining or online post-training pipelines, then also check the appendix discussion on divergence choice and training stability.

recommendation.zh: 值得看它如何把“失败反馈”变成 token 级纠错监督；但要重点审计反思生成是否泄漏答案/引入额外算力，先读方法与消融再信结论。
recommendation.en: Worth reading for the mechanism that converts failure feedback into token-level corrective supervision; scrutinize leakage/extra-compute in reflection generation—read method + ablations before trusting the gains.

paper.title: Self-Distilled Trajectory-Aware Boltzmann Modeling: Bridging the Training-Inference Discrepancy in Diffusion Language Models
paper.abstract: Diffusion Language Models (DLMs) have recently emerged as a promising alternative to autoregressive language models, offering stronger global awareness and highly parallel generation. However, post-training DLMs with standard Negative Evidence Lower Bound (NELBO)-based supervised fine-tuning remains inefficient: training reconstructs randomly masked tokens in a single step, whereas inference follows a confidence-guided, multi-step easy-to-hard denoising trajectory. Recent trajectory-based self-d

summary.core_problem: 这项工作解决 diffusion language model 后训练中的训练—推理不一致问题：训练时用 NELBO 做随机 mask 的单步重建，推理时却沿着置信度驱动的多步 easy-to-hard 去噪轨迹逐步解码。已有自蒸馏轨迹方法多用于压缩采样步数，能改善解码效率，但不一定提升完整 diffusion 解码下的模型能力，甚至可能带来性能下降。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发在于，它把 DLM 的后训练目标从“拟合答案 token”推进到“拟合推理时的熵结构”。这对非 AR 语言模型很关键：DLM 的能力瓶颈不只来自数据或模型规模，也来自训练目标是否能塑造正确的去噪顺序和不确定性地形。它不是新的基座预训练范式，但对 DLM 的 SFT、轨迹蒸馏、RL 替代目标设计有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 方法名为 TABOM，即 Trajectory-Aligned Optimization via Boltzmann Modeling。核心做法是先用基座 DLM 生成自蒸馏去噪轨迹，再把推理时的 unmask 分布建模为关于 token 理想预测熵的 Boltzmann 分布；低熵 token 应更早被确定，高熵 token 应更晚被处理。直接最小化全局 KL 难以操作，因此作者用 pairwise ranking surrogate 近似优化，要求轨迹中 token 的局部熵排序符合 easy-to-hard 解码顺序。相比普通 NELBO，这个目标不只是让模型重建被 mask token，而是让模型的熵梯度与实际解码过程一致。
summary.experiments: 实验基于 Dream DLM，在代码生成和数学推理上比较 ground-truth SFT 与 self-distilled trajectory SFT。代码数据从 Ling-Coder-SFT 随机采样 17K queries，数学数据来自 MixChain-Z-PRM12K；用 entropy-based decoding 生成有效自蒸馏轨迹，代码约 3.8K 条，数学约 5.1K 条。经验观察是，自蒸馏数据相对离线 GT 数据有更低优化障碍，但直接用标准 NELBO 微调只带来有限收益。TABOM 的实验主张是能把自蒸馏轨迹转化为更稳定的性能提升，同时保留 OOD 能力，缓解标准 SFT 常见的遗忘。作者还提出 Trajectory Discrimination Score，用来量化模型是否保留轨迹中的 token 级不确定性差异；Figure 2 和 Table 6 用于说明 TABOM 改变的是熵景观，而不是简单复用生成样本。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 30–45 分钟。先看 Introduction 中对 NELBO、DLM 推理轨迹、RL 不适配性的分析，这是问题定义的核心。然后看 empirical observations 部分，重点理解 self-distilled data 为什么优化更容易、为什么 naive NELBO 仍然不够。技术部分优先读 Section 3.1 的 Boltzmann 建模和 Section 3.2 的 pairwise ranking 目标；实验部分看 Section 4.1 的性能与遗忘结果，以及 Figure 2、Table 6 对 TDS 的分析。

summary_en.core_problem: The work targets a concrete training-inference mismatch in diffusion language models. Standard NELBO-based SFT trains the model to reconstruct randomly masked tokens in one step, while inference follows a multi-step confidence-guided denoising path that reveals tokens from easy to hard.
summary_en.importance: Its main value for pretraining-oriented research is the objective-level view of DLM post-training. The paper argues that improving a DLM is not only about adding supervised targets or compressing sampling steps; the training loss should also shape the entropy ordering used at inference time. This is relevant to non-autoregressive language modeling, trajectory distillation, and possible alternatives to rollout-heavy RL for DLMs.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed method, TABOM, uses self-distilled denoising trajectories generated by the base DLM. It models the inference-time unmasking distribution as a Boltzmann distribution over ideal token-level predictive entropy, where easier low-entropy tokens should be selected earlier. Since the resulting global KL objective is not tractable in practice, the method uses a pairwise ranking surrogate that enforces local entropy order along the trajectory. This differs from ordinary NELBO fine-tuning because the target is not just token reconstruction, but alignment between the model’s uncertainty landscape and its actual decoding schedule.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments are conducted on the Dream diffusion language model for code generation and mathematical reasoning. The code setting samples 17K queries from Ling-Coder-SFT, and the math setting uses MixChain-Z-PRM12K. Entropy-based decoding yields about 3.8K valid self-distilled trajectories for code and about 5.1K for math. The paper reports that self-distilled trajectories have a lower optimization barrier than offline ground-truth data, but naive NELBO training gives only marginal gains. TABOM is reported to improve performance while preserving out-of-distribution capability and reducing forgetting. The Trajectory Discrimination Score is introduced to measure whether token-level uncertainty gaps along the denoising path are preserved; Figure 2 and Table 6 are the key references for this claim.
summary_en.reading_guide: A focused skim should take around 30–45 minutes. Start with the introduction for the mismatch between random masking and easy-to-hard inference, and for why outcome-reward RL is expensive and poorly aligned for DLMs. Then read the empirical observation section to understand why self-distilled trajectories help optimization but are insufficient under NELBO. The main technical parts are Section 3.1 on the Boltzmann formulation and Section 3.2 on the pairwise ranking surrogate. For results, prioritize Section 4.1, Figure 2, and Table 6.

recommendation.zh: 这篇值得看，因为它直指 DLM 最麻烦的 train-test mismatch；先看目标函数和 full-step decoding 结果，若提升只在压缩步数下成立，就当工程技巧看。
recommendation.en: Worth reading because it hits the core DLM train-test mismatch; inspect the objective and the full-step decoding results first—if gains only survive under compressed sampling, treat it as an engineering trick, not a modeling advance.

paper.title: Adaptive Teacher Exposure for Self-Distillation in LLM Reasoning
paper.abstract: On-policy self-distillation has become a strong recipe for LLM reasoning, where a privileged teacher supervises the student's own rollouts while conditioning on the reference solution. A design choice shared by nearly all such methods, however, has gone unquestioned: the teacher always sees the full reference reasoning. We argue that this default itself is part of the problem and identify a teacher-side exposure mismatch: when the teacher conditions on reasoning far beyond the student's current

summary.core_problem: 论文处理的是 on-policy self-distillation 中一个被默认忽略的设计点：teacher 在给学生 rollouts 做 token-level 监督时，是否应该总是看到完整参考推理。作者指出，full exposure 会造成 teacher-side exposure mismatch：teacher 条件中包含的推理信息超过学生当前能力，生成的软目标过强，学生难以吸收。
summary.importance: 这篇论文对 reasoning post-training 更直接，但对预训练研究也有接口意义。它把“监督信号强度”从固定超参变成可学习控制变量，说明更强的 teacher context 不一定带来更好的学习信号。这个结论可以迁移到 curriculum、self-training、process supervision、RL 数据构造等场景：关键不是给模型最多信息，而是让目标分布落在当前模型可学习的范围内。
summary.technical_approach: 方法叫 ATESD。基础框架是 OPSD：同一个模型同时作为 student 和 teacher。student 只看题目并生成 on-policy rollout；teacher 额外看参考解，对同一条 rollout 给出 token 分布；训练时只更新 student，最小化 teacher 到 student 的逐 token forward KL，并使用 KL clipping 稳定训练。论文的改动是把 teacher 可见的参考推理比例设为连续变量 α∈[0,1]，而不是固定为 1。作者先做固定 exposure sweep，发现 α=0.5 一类中等暴露比 full exposure 更稳；同时 teacher-student mismatch 随 α 单调增长。ATESD 用一个轻量 Beta-policy controller，根据训练状态统计量输出 α。controller 不是每步更新，而是在 hold window 内保持一个 exposure 决策；student 每个 distillation step 更新；controller 通过 REINFORCE 使用 discounted learning-progress reward 更新。这个 reward 评估 exposure 决策对后续若干步学生提升的影响，避免用单步 KD loss 下降来错误归因。
summary.experiments: 论文在 AIME 2024、AIME 2025、HMMT 2025 上评估，模型包括 Qwen3-1.7B、Qwen3-4B、Qwen3-8B。固定 exposure 实验显示两个现象：full exposure 不是可靠最优；teacher-student mismatch 随 exposure 增大而单调上升。难度分桶分析显示，不同题目难度和训练阶段偏好的 exposure 不同，支持自适应控制。主结果中，ATESD 在这些数学推理 benchmark 上持续优于 self-distillation 与 RL baseline；Qwen3-4B 达到 65.65 Average@12。消融的核心信息是：连续 exposure 控制、hold/lookahead 两时间尺度、用未来学习进展而不是单步代理 reward，对效果都很关键。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 25–35 分钟。重点看三处：第一，§3.2 的 fixed-exposure sweep，那里给出 full exposure 失效和 mismatch 单调增长的证据；第二，方法部分关于 Beta controller、hold/lookahead schedule、discounted learning-progress reward 的定义，这是论文主要机制；第三，主实验和消融表，关注 ATESD 相比 OPSD、固定 α、RL baseline 的差距。若只关心可迁移启发，可重点读 exposure mismatch 的定义和 reward 设计，不必深读所有数学 benchmark 细节。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies an overlooked design choice in on-policy self-distillation for reasoning: whether the teacher should always condition on the full reference reasoning when supervising the student’s own rollouts. The authors identify a teacher-side exposure mismatch. When the teacher sees reasoning far beyond the student’s current capability, its token targets become too strong and less learnable.
summary_en.importance: The work is mainly about reasoning post-training, but the lesson is relevant to pretraining-adjacent training design. It treats the strength of the supervision signal as a controllable variable rather than a fixed assumption. More privileged context for the teacher does not necessarily produce better learning targets. The same issue can appear in curriculum learning, self-training, process supervision, RL data generation, and other settings where model-generated trajectories are trained against stronger conditional distributions.
summary_en.technical_approach: ATESD builds on OPSD. In OPSD, the student conditions only on the problem and samples an on-policy rollout. The teacher is the same model under a privileged context that includes the reference solution, and it provides token-level distributions along the student rollout. Training minimizes a clipped per-token forward KL, with gradients flowing only through the student. ATESD changes the teacher context from full reference exposure to a continuous exposure level α∈[0,1]. A preliminary fixed-exposure sweep shows that intermediate exposure, such as α=0.5, can outperform full exposure, while teacher-student mismatch grows monotonically with α. The method uses a lightweight Beta-policy controller that maps compact training-state statistics to an exposure value. The controller holds one global exposure over a window, while the student updates every distillation step. The controller is trained with REINFORCE using a discounted learning-progress reward, so exposure decisions are credited by their effect on future student improvement rather than by immediate KD-loss reduction.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments cover AIME 2024, AIME 2025, and HMMT 2025 with Qwen3-1.7B, Qwen3-4B, and Qwen3-8B. The fixed-exposure study reports two key patterns: full exposure is not a reliable optimum, and teacher-student mismatch increases as exposure grows. Difficulty-binned analysis indicates that different problem regimes prefer different exposure levels, motivating adaptive control. In the main results, ATESD consistently improves over self-distillation and RL baselines. On Qwen3-4B, it reaches 65.65 Average@12. The main ablation signal is that adaptive exposure, the two-timescale hold/lookahead schedule, and the future learning-progress reward are central to the gains.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim time: about 25–35 minutes. Read the fixed-exposure sweep in §3.2 first, because it establishes why full teacher exposure is not a safe default. Then read the method section for the Beta controller, the hold/lookahead schedule, and the discounted learning-progress reward. Finally, inspect the main result and ablation tables to see how much of the gain comes from adaptive exposure versus the reward and scheduling choices. Readers mainly interested in transferable training insights can focus on the mismatch definition and credit-assignment design.

recommendation.zh: 值得看 exposure sweep；它提醒我们别迷信更强 teacher，目标分布太远会把蒸馏信号做脏。
recommendation.en: Read the exposure sweep; it is a useful warning that a stronger teacher can make distillation targets less learnable.

paper.title: Anti-Self-Distillation for Reasoning RL via Pointwise Mutual Information
paper.abstract: On-policy self-distillation, where a student is pulled toward a copy of itself conditioned on privileged context (e.g., a verified solution or feedback), offers a promising direction for advancing reasoning capability without a stronger external teacher. Yet in math reasoning the gains are inconsistent, even when the same approach succeeds elsewhere. A pointwise mutual information analysis traces the failure to the privileged context itself: it inflates the teacher's confidence on tokens already

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决 reasoning RL 中 on-policy self-distillation 在数学推理上收益不稳定的问题。标准做法让同一个模型在带有 verified solution 或环境反馈的 privileged context 下充当 teacher，再用逐 token KL 拉近 student。论文指出，在数学题中，这个 teacher 会更确信那些已由答案暗示的结构词和可验证陈述，却降低对 Wait、Let、Maybe 等探索性推理 token 的支持。结果是蒸馏信号削弱了多步搜索所需的 deliberation。
summary.importance: 这篇工作属于 post-train / RL reasoning 方法，但对预训练研究也有间接价值。它说明 token-level 训练信号的方向比“是否更有信息”更关键。带答案的上下文并不一定提供好的中间过程监督；它可能鼓励捷径式轨迹，而不是鼓励模型保留搜索空间。这个观察对 RL pretrain、过程监督、合成推理数据过滤都有借鉴意义：训练信号需要区分“答案已知后的解释”与“求解过程中的探索”。
summary.technical_approach: 论文先用 pointwise mutual information 分析自蒸馏信号。teacher 分布为 πθ(· | x, c, y_<t)，其中 c 是训练时可见的 verified solution 或反馈；student 分布为 πθ(· | x, y_<t)。标准 self-distillation 最小化 student 到 teacher 的逐 token divergence，相当于奖励在 privileged context 下概率上升的 token。问题是，privileged context 会让 teacher 像 oracle 一样偏向已知答案所支持的 token，而不是偏向求解时有用的探索 token。Anti-Self-Distillation 的处理很直接：不下降 divergence，而是上升 student 与 teacher 之间的 Jensen-Shannon divergence，从而反转逐 token 信号。JSD 的形状给 advantage 提供天然边界，减少梯度过大风险；另外加入 entropy-triggered gate，当 teacher 的逐 token 熵塌缩时关闭该项，避免过度推开一个已过于确定的 teacher。方法可作为 GRPO 中逐 token 辅助项的替换，不需要外部 teacher 或单独的 process reward model。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 5 个 4B–30B 模型，主要评测数学推理，也包含 coding 任务。数学基准包括 AIME 2024 和 AIME 2025。结果显示，默认 self-distillation 通常不能稳定超过强 GRPO baseline；AntiSD 能在 2–10 倍更少的训练 step 内达到 GRPO baseline 的准确率，并在最终准确率上最高提升 11.5 个百分点。诊断实验表明，默认蒸馏会增强结构连接词和答案相关声明的概率，同时压低 deliberation token；反向 JSD 后，这个逐 token 信号方向被翻转。消融中，JSD 的有界性和 entropy gate 是稳定训练的关键组件。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 30–40 分钟。先看 Section 3.1 的 conditional PMI 推导，这是理解方法动机的核心；再看 Section 3.2 中 AntiSD 如何从 divergence descent 改成 divergence ascent，以及为什么选 JSD 而不是普通 KL。实验部分重点看 Figure 1、Figure 2、Section 4.1 的模型规模 sweep，以及 entropy gate 和 divergence choice 的消融。若关注 RLVR 训练稳定性，可以细读 advantage 形状和 gate 触发条件。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses why on-policy self-distillation gives inconsistent gains for math reasoning. In the standard setup, the same model acts as a teacher under privileged context, such as a verified solution or feedback, and the student is trained to match that teacher token by token. The paper shows that this privileged teacher becomes confident on tokens already implied by the known solution, while assigning less support to deliberative tokens such as Wait, Let, and Maybe. This weakens the exploratory behavior needed for multi-step reasoning.
summary_en.importance: This is a post-training and reasoning-RL paper, but it has useful implications for pretraining-oriented researchers who care about training signals. It shows that richer conditioning is not automatically better supervision. A solution-conditioned teacher may produce a shortcut signal: it rewards tokens that make sense after the answer is known, not tokens that help discover the answer. The lesson transfers to RL pretraining, process supervision, and synthetic reasoning-data construction: token-level signals should distinguish retrospective explanation from search-time deliberation.
summary_en.technical_approach: The analysis starts from a pointwise mutual information view of self-distillation. The student distribution is πθ(· | x, y_<t), while the teacher distribution is πθ(· | x, c, y_<t), with c denoting privileged training-only context. Standard self-distillation minimizes a token-level divergence between them, so tokens whose probability increases under c receive positive pressure. In math reasoning, this favors solution-implied structure and verifiable claims, while suppressing tokens used for reconsideration and branching. Anti-Self-Distillation reverses this pressure by ascending a Jensen-Shannon divergence between student and teacher instead of descending it. The JSD form gives a bounded token-level advantage, and an entropy-triggered gate disables the term when the teacher distribution becomes too collapsed. The method can be inserted into GRPO as a replacement for the usual self-distillation auxiliary loss, without using an external teacher or a separate process reward model.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments cover five models from 4B to 30B parameters on math reasoning benchmarks, including AIME 2024 and AIME 2025, with additional coding evaluations. Default self-distillation often fails to beat a strong GRPO baseline. AntiSD reaches the GRPO baseline accuracy in 2x to 10x fewer training steps and improves final accuracy by up to 11.5 points. Token-level diagnostics show the intended sign change: the standard loss reinforces tokens implied by the privileged solution, while AntiSD pushes back against that shortcut signal. Ablations indicate that the bounded shape of JSD and the entropy gate are important for stable training.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in 30–40 minutes. Start with Section 3.1 for the conditional PMI identity, since it explains the failure mode rather than just proposing a new loss. Then read Section 3.2 for the divergence-ascent objective, the choice of JSD, and the entropy gate. In the experiments, focus on Figure 1, Figure 2, the model-size sweep in Section 4.1, and ablations on divergence choice and gating. Readers working on RLVR stability should pay special attention to the induced token-level advantage shape.

recommendation.zh: 值得看的是它对 self-distill 失败机制的 token 级拆解，不是方法名本身；先看 PMI 分析和 entropy gate，若 setup 不干净就把结论当弱信号。
recommendation.en: The useful part is the token-level diagnosis of why self-distillation fails, not the method name; read the PMI analysis and entropy gate first, and treat the gains as weak evidence unless the setup is unusually clean.

institutions: Institute of Automation, Chinese Academy of Sciences

paper.title: GEAR: Granularity-Adaptive Advantage Reweighting for LLM Agents via Self-Distillation
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning has become a widely used post-training approach for LLM agents, where training commonly relies on outcome-level rewards that provide only coarse supervision. While finer-grained credit assignment is promising for effective policy updates, obtaining reliable local credit and assigning it to the right parts of the long-horizon trajectory remains an open challenge. In this paper, we propose Granularity-adaptivE Advantage Reweighting (GEAR), an adaptive-granularity credit assi

summary.core_problem: GEAR 处理的是长轨迹 LLM Agent 强化学习中的信用分配问题。GRPO 这类方法通常只有最终 outcome reward，整条轨迹共享同一个 advantage，容易把成功轨迹中的局部坏动作一起强化，也会把失败轨迹中的局部好动作一起惩罚。问题不只是信号太粗，还包括信用应该分配到什么粒度：token、turn、tool call 或人工 segment 都可能和真实行为单元不匹配。
summary.importance: 这篇工作的启发点在于，它没有直接训练 process reward model，也没有要求人工标注中间步骤，而是尝试把 trajectory-level advantage 改造成局部加权信号。对预训练研究的直接价值有限，更接近 post-training/RL for agents；但它对“如何从粗粒度可验证奖励中抽取更密的训练信号”有参考意义。这个问题也会影响 RL pretrain、长上下文任务训练、tool-use 数据构造和 verifier-guided learning。
summary.technical_approach: GEAR 的核心做法是用自蒸馏构造一个任务相关的局部偏差信号，再用这个信号重加权 GRPO 的 advantage。具体来说，论文用同一个模型构造 ground-truth-conditioned teacher，也就是在可见正确答案或正确条件的情况下生成参考分布；on-policy student 则按当前策略生成轨迹。二者之间的 reverse KL 被用来衡量学生在某个位置是否偏离了“更接近任务正确延续”的行为。KL 较大的位置通常对应推理路径发生转向或承诺的地方。论文进一步用 token entropy 作为边界信号，因为高熵位置常对应不确定性或语义转折，从而把单点 KL spike 扩展成更合理的行为片段。最后，GEAR 不引入显式 step reward，而是把 token-level aligned region 和 segment-level divergent region 转换成局部权重，对原始 trajectory-level advantage 做重新分布。重加权是 advantage-aware 的：成功轨迹中，高 divergence 区域被降权，避免强化不稳定偏离；失败轨迹中，高 divergence 区域受到更强惩罚。
summary.experiments: 当前可见内容主要给出问题设定、方法动机和框架设计，没有提供可核验的完整实验表格、任务列表、模型规模、训练 token 数、性能提升幅度或消融结果。文中提到一个经验观察：reverse KL spike 常出现在“so”“but”“therefore”等转折标记附近，说明这些位置可能是推理路径改变或决策承诺的边界。真正需要核对的实验包括：GEAR 相比 vanilla GRPO 的成功率提升；KL 信号、entropy 边界、segment reweighting 各自的消融；在成功轨迹降权和失败轨迹加罚这两个方向上的贡献；以及额外 teacher forward 带来的训练开销。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 20–30 分钟。重点看方法部分中 teacher/student 分布如何构造、reverse KL 如何计算、entropy 如何确定 segment 边界、local weight 如何进入 GRPO loss。实验部分若完整可得，应优先看 credit assignment 可视化、消融表和训练稳定性曲线。需要特别留意两个风险点：第一，ground-truth-conditioned teacher 是否泄露了过强的答案条件，导致训练信号和真实推理过程不一致；第二，KL divergence 衡量的是分布偏离，不一定等价于任务贡献，尤其在多条正确路径并存的 agent 任务中。

summary_en.core_problem: GEAR targets credit assignment in long-horizon RL for LLM agents. Methods such as GRPO usually optimize full trajectories with outcome-only rewards, so every token or action receives the same trajectory-level advantage. This can reinforce locally harmful behaviors in successful trajectories and penalize useful intermediate behaviors in failed ones. The difficult part is not only the lack of dense supervision, but also the choice of granularity: tokens, turns, tool calls, and heuristic segments often do not match the actual behavioral unit that should receive credit.
summary_en.importance: The main value is in post-training and agent RL rather than base pretraining. Still, it is relevant to pretraining researchers because it studies how to extract denser learning signals from coarse verifiable rewards. That question also appears in RL-style pretraining, long-context curriculum design, tool-use data generation, and verifier-guided training. The contribution is a credit-reshaping mechanism that avoids training a separate process reward model or requiring step-level human annotations.
summary_en.technical_approach: GEAR reshapes the trajectory-level GRPO advantage using local weights derived from self-distillation. It constructs a task-grounded teacher by conditioning the same model on ground-truth information, and compares this teacher distribution with the on-policy student distribution. The reverse KL between the two distributions is used as a reference-guided deviation signal. Large reverse KL values indicate positions where the student starts to depart from a task-correct continuation. The method then uses token entropy as a boundary signal, since entropy spikes often mark uncertainty or semantic transitions, and expands pointwise divergence into adaptive behavioral segments. The resulting token-level aligned regions and segment-level divergent regions are converted into local credit weights. The reweighting depends on the sign of the trajectory advantage: in successful trajectories, highly divergent regions are down-weighted to avoid reinforcing unstable deviations; in failed trajectories, they receive stronger penalties.
summary_en.experiments: The provided content contains the motivation and method design but does not include complete experimental tables, model sizes, training scale, benchmark details, or numerical gains. One reported qualitative observation is that reverse-KL spikes often occur around transition markers such as “so,” “but,” and “therefore,” which supports the use of divergence as a signal for reasoning-path shifts. The key empirical checks are the improvement over vanilla GRPO, ablations for the KL signal, entropy-based boundary detection, and segment-level reweighting, as well as the extra compute cost from the teacher forward pass.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in 20–30 minutes. Focus on the construction of the teacher and student distributions, the reverse-KL computation, the entropy-based segmentation rule, and how the local weights enter the GRPO objective. If the full experimental section is available, prioritize the ablation table, credit-assignment visualizations, and training stability curves. Two points deserve scrutiny: whether the ground-truth-conditioned teacher introduces a mismatch with test-time reasoning, and whether distributional deviation is a reliable proxy for task contribution when multiple valid solution paths exist.

recommendation.zh: 这是后训练里少数值得看的 credit assignment 论文：先看 divergence spike 是否真对齐语义偏离点；若成立，很多长轨迹 RL 的 reward shaping 可以重写。
recommendation.en: This is one of the few credit-assignment papers in post-training worth reading: first check whether divergence spikes truly align with semantic deviation onsets; if they do, a lot of long-horizon RL reward shaping should be rewritten.

institutions: Hong Kong University of Science and Technology

paper.title: The Many Faces of On-Policy Distillation: Pitfalls, Mechanisms, and Fixes
paper.abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) and on-policy self-distillation (OPSD) have emerged as promising post-training methods for large language models, offering dense token-level supervision on trajectories sampled from the model's own policy. However, existing results on their effectiveness remain mixed: while OP(S)D has shown promise in system prompt and knowledge internalization, recent studies also report instability and degradation. In this work, we present a comprehensive empirical study of when OP

summary.core_problem: 现有LLM后训练中使用的on-policy蒸馏（OPD）和on-policy自蒸馏（OPSD）效果存在明显场景差异，部分场景下不稳定甚至导致性能退化，目前缺乏对其生效/失效机制的系统分析，也没有针对性的稳定化方案。
summary.importance: 明确了OP(S)D这类后训练蒸馏方法的适用边界，其失效机制分析可以指导预训练与后训练的衔接设计，提出的稳定化方案可以降低后训练阶段的性能退化风险，为规模化蒸馏流水线提供可落地的优化方向，避免盲目套用OP(S)D带来的训练不稳定问题。
summary.technical_approach: 首先系统梳理了OP(S)D的完整设计空间，覆盖教师构造（自蒸馏/冻结教师/EMA教师）、特权信息（PI）类型（无/仅答案/完整回复/系统提示）、蒸馏损失设计（全词表KL/采样token策略梯度/Top-K反向KL/停止梯度Top-K）三类维度。随后识别出三个核心失效机制：1）学生生成的前缀会将教师带入局部状态，使其token级监督信号与学生轨迹不兼容；2）Top-K反向KL的近似计算会引入有偏梯度，破坏优化稳定性；3）OPSD只能学到跨实例的无PI共识策略，当PI为实例特定信息（如数学题的标准答案）时无法生效。最后提出三个针对性稳定化方案：带停止梯度的Top-K KL代理损失以消除有偏梯度、用可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）适配教师以提升任务对齐度、对学生做SFT以规范输出格式并稳定回复长度。
summary.experiments: 在数学推理、系统提示内化、对齐三类任务上完成对比验证：1）数学推理任务中，OPD效果高度依赖教师选择和损失形式，容易出现长度爆炸、内容重复、师生监督错位问题，OPSD在测试的所有数学推理设置下完全失效；2）系统提示内化和对齐任务中，OPSD表现稳定有效，因为这类场景下PI诱导的是共享的潜在行为，可以压缩为测试时无PI的通用策略；3）提出的三类稳定化方案可分别缓解对应失效机制，显著降低OPD在推理任务上的不稳定性和性能退化概率。
summary.reading_guide: 先阅读第1节的图1，快速把握OP(S)D的设计空间、失效场景和修复方案的整体框架；再重点读第3节的三个失效机制的具体分析；最后扫一眼稳定化方案的核心效果结论。不需要精读损失函数的公式推导细节，预计阅读时间20-30分钟。
summary.authors_note: 包含UIUC研究人员，其中一位作者为UIUC实习期间完成该工作，其余作者背景未披露。

summary_en.core_problem: On-policy distillation (OPD) and on-policy self-distillation (OPSD) used in LLM post-training show significant scenario-dependent performance, with instability and even performance degradation in some settings. There is no systematic analysis of their working/failure mechanisms, nor targeted stabilization solutions.
summary_en.importance: Clarifies the applicable boundaries of OP(S)D post-training distillation methods. Its failure mechanism analysis can guide the interface design between pretraining and post-training, and the proposed stabilizers reduce the risk of performance degradation in post-training stages, providing implementable optimization directions for large-scale distillation pipelines to avoid training instability caused by blind application of OP(S)D.
summary_en.technical_approach: First maps the full OP(S)D design space across three dimensions: teacher construction (self-distillation / frozen teacher / EMA teacher), privileged information (PI) types (none / answer only / full response / system prompt), and distillation loss design (full-vocab KL / sampled-token policy gradient / Top-K reverse KL / stop-gradient Top-K). Then identifies three core failure mechanisms: 1) student-generated prefixes push the teacher into local states where its token-level supervision is incompatible with the student trajectory; 2) Top-K reverse KL approximation introduces biased gradients that destabilize optimization; 3) OPSD only learns a single PI-free consensus policy across instances, which fails when PI is instance-specific (e.g., ground-truth answers for math problems). Finally proposes three targeted stabilizers: stop-gradient Top-K KL surrogate to eliminate biased gradients, RL with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) adapted teachers to improve task alignment, and student SFT to standardize output format and stabilize response length.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated across three task categories: mathematical reasoning, system prompt internalization, and alignment. 1) On math reasoning, OPD performance is highly sensitive to teacher selection and loss formulation, prone to length explosion, repetition, and teacher-student supervision mismatch, while OPSD fails completely in all tested math reasoning settings. 2) On system prompt internalization and alignment, OPSD works stably as PI induces shared latent behavior that can be compressed into a general PI-free policy for test time. 3) The three proposed stabilizers mitigate corresponding failure modes and significantly reduce OPD instability and performance degradation on reasoning tasks.
summary_en.reading_guide: Start with Figure 1 in Section 1 for a high-level overview of OP(S)D design space, failure scenarios and fixes. Then focus on the detailed analysis of three failure mechanisms in Section 3, and finally scan the core effect conclusions of the stabilizers. No need to dive into detailed formula derivations of loss functions, estimated reading time: 20-30 minutes.
summary_en.authors_note: Affiliated with UIUC; one author completed the work during an internship at UIUC, other author backgrounds are not disclosed.

recommendation.zh: 只看机制实验和修复部分即可；它提醒 OPD 不是免费午餐，PI 的训练-测试可见性比 loss 名字更关键。
recommendation.en: Read the mechanism and fix sections; the useful prior update is that OPD is not free, and PI visibility across train/test matters more than the loss label.

paper.title: From Generic Correlation to Input-Specific Credit in On-Policy Self Distillation
paper.abstract: On-policy self-distillation has emerged as a promising paradigm for post-training language models, in which the model conditions on environment feedback to serve as its own teacher, providing dense token-level rewards without external teacher models or step-level annotations. Despite its empirical success, what this reward actually measures and what kind of credit it assigns remain unclear. Under a posterior-compatibility interpretation of feedback conditioning, standard in the implicit-reward l

summary.core_problem: 同策略自蒸馏（OPSD）作为RL后训练的稠密奖励构造方法不需要外部教师和步级标注，但现有自蒸馏奖励的实际含义、信用分配机制不明确，存在输入通用相关性偏差，会奖励跨输入通用的反馈相关模式而非当前输入特有的推理贡献，导致优化偏移。
summary.importance: 从理论上厘清了自蒸馏奖励的数学含义，提出的偏差校正方法可提升自蒸馏的信用分配准确性，为RL后训练的稠密奖励构造提供了理论支撑和实用改进方案。
summary.technical_approach: 在贝叶斯后验兼容假设下证明自蒸馏token奖励是贝叶斯滤波增量，其轨迹和等于给定输入下响应与反馈的点互信息，点互信息同时包含输入特有推理贡献和输入通用快捷模式两部分。基于此提出Credit（对比蒸馏奖励）方法，通过批内对比抑制输入通用偏差分量，保留输入特有信用信号，额外计算开销极低。
summary.experiments: 在代码生成、数学推理等可验证奖励任务上，Credit相比标准同策略自蒸馏提升了整体性能，无额外标注需求，计算开销可忽略。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议看引言部分的自蒸馏奖励解释和偏差分析，以及方法部分的Credit对比校正设计，预计阅读时间20分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD), a dense reward construction method for RL post-training, does not require external teachers or step-level annotations, but the actual meaning and credit assignment mechanism of existing self-distillation rewards are unclear. It has input-generic correlation bias, which rewards cross-input generic feedback-related patterns instead of reasoning contributions specific to the current input, leading to optimization deviation.
summary_en.importance: It theoretically clarifies the mathematical meaning of self-distillation rewards, and the proposed bias correction method improves the credit assignment accuracy of self-distillation, providing theoretical support and practical improvement scheme for dense reward construction in RL post-training.
summary_en.technical_approach: Under the Bayesian posterior compatibility assumption, it proves that the self-distillation token reward is a Bayesian filtering increment, whose trajectory sum equals the pointwise mutual information between response and feedback given the input. The pointwise mutual information includes both input-specific reasoning contribution and input-generic shortcut patterns. The Credit (Contrastive Reward from Distillation) method is proposed to suppress the input-generic bias component via in-batch contrast, preserving input-specific credit signals with negligible extra computation overhead.
summary_en.experiments: On verifiable reward tasks such as code generation and mathematical reasoning, Credit outperforms standard on-policy self-distillation on overall performance, with no additional annotation requirement and negligible computation overhead.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the self-distillation reward interpretation and bias analysis in the introduction section, as well as the Credit contrastive correction design in the method section. Estimated reading time: 20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 只看推导和 CREDIT 消融即可；它把“自蒸馏 reward 等于好推理”这个 prior 拆得比较干净。
recommendation.en: Read the derivation and CREDIT ablations; it cleanly challenges the prior that self-distillation rewards are faithful reasoning credit.

institutions: Institute of Automation, Chinese Academy of Sciences

paper.title: SHRED: Retain-Set-Free Unlearning via Self-Distillation with Logit Demotion
paper.abstract: Machine unlearning for large language models (LLMs) aims to selectively remove memorized content such as private data, copyrighted text, or hazardous knowledge, without costly full retraining. Most existing methods require a retain set of curated examples to prevent catastrophic degradation of general model utility, creating an extra data dependency that complicates deployment. We propose SHRED (Self-distillation via High-surprisal-only Retain-set-free Entropy Demotion), a retain-set-free unlear

summary.core_problem: 现有大模型机器遗忘方法大多依赖人工构造的保留集防止通用能力下降，保留集获取成本高且易引入领域偏置，无保留集的遗忘方法通常会严重损伤模型通用性能。
summary.importance: 在无保留集的前提下同时保证遗忘效果和通用能力保留，为预训练模型的事后数据合规、隐私移除提供了轻量化方案，无额外数据依赖，可适配持续遗忘场景。
summary.technical_approach: 核心洞察是遗忘集中的token记忆权重不均：高信息token（姓名、特定事件、特殊关系）对应模型预测的相对概率更低，低信息token（标点、停用词、通用表达）对应相对概率更高，反映通用语言能力。SHRED分为四个步骤：1）识别遗忘集中的高信息token位置；2）对高信息位置的对应token概率做降级处理，低信息位置保留原模型输出分布；3）以修改后的分布作为自蒸馏的教师信号；4）最小化待更新模型和教师信号的KL散度完成遗忘，全程不引入额外保留集。
summary.experiments: 在TOFU、MUSE、RWKU、Hubble四个常用遗忘基准上取得遗忘效果-通用能力 tradeoff的最优帕累托边界；抗重学习、成员推理攻击性能稳定，支持多轮持续遗忘；小批次更新下tradeoff最优，可适配小样本遗忘集；在TOFU基准上可主动修正模型因记忆产生的幻觉。
summary.reading_guide: 重点看第3章方法部分的token信息度判定逻辑和自蒸馏目标设计，第4章验证保留集无依赖有效性的消融实验，预计阅读时间15分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing LLM machine unlearning methods mostly rely on manually curated retain sets to prevent general capability degradation. Retain sets are costly to acquire and prone to introduce domain bias, while retain-set-free unlearning methods usually cause severe damage to model utility.
summary_en.importance: It achieves both effective unlearning and general capability preservation without any retain set, providing a lightweight solution for post-hoc data compliance and privacy removal of pretrained models, with no extra data dependency and adaptability to continual unlearning scenarios.
summary_en.technical_approach: The core insight is that tokens in the forget set have uneven memorization weights: high-information tokens (names, specific events, unique relations) correspond to lower relative prediction probability of the model, while low-information tokens (punctuation, stopwords, common expressions) correspond to higher relative probability that reflects general language competence. SHRED has four stages: 1) Identify high-information token positions in the forget set; 2) Demote the probability of target tokens at high-information positions, while keeping the original model output distribution at low-information positions; 3) Use the modified distribution as the teacher signal for self-distillation; 4) Minimize the KL divergence between the updated model and the teacher signal to complete unlearning, with no extra retain set introduced throughout the process.
summary_en.experiments: It reaches the optimal Pareto frontier of unlearning effect-general utility tradeoff on four common unlearning benchmarks: TOFU, MUSE, RWKU, Hubble. It is robust against relearning and membership inference attacks, and supports multi-round continual unlearning. The tradeoff performs best under small-batch updates, which adapts to small forget sets. It can actively correct hallucinations caused by memorization on the TOFU benchmark.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the token informativeness judgment logic and self-distillation objective design in Section 3 (Method), and the ablation experiments verifying retain-set-free effectiveness in Section 4. Estimated reading time: 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 无需retain set的unlearning是实用进展，高信息token集中记忆的insight对理解LLM记忆机制有一定启发，建议skim方法部分。
recommendation.en: Retain-set-free unlearning is a practical advance; the insight that high-information tokens concentrate memorized knowledge is mildly illuminating for understanding LLM memory mechanisms. Skim the method section.

paper.title: OPSD Compresses What RLVR Teaches: A Post-RL Compaction Stage for Reasoning Models
paper.abstract: On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD) has recently emerged as an alternative to Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR), promising higher accuracy and shorter responses through token-level credit assignment from a self-teacher conditioned on privileged context. However, this promise does not carry over to thinking-enabled mathematical reasoning, where reported accuracy gains shrink and sometimes turn negative. We hypothesize that hindsight supervision can specify better token-level al

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文分析 OPSD 在 thinking-enabled 数学推理中为什么很难替代 RLVR：它更擅长压缩已经正确的长推理轨迹，而不是修复错误轨迹。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接关系不强，但对 pretrain 与 post-train 接口有价值。它把 OPSD 的作用边界讲得比较清楚：token-level hindsight signal 在短输出里可能能给出替代 token，但在长链式推理里很难稳定指出“正确的下一步”。因此，OPSD 更像 post-RL 的推理轨迹压缩阶段，而不是发现新推理能力的训练阶段。这个结论对设计 reasoning model 的训练流水线有实际影响：SFT 负责格式，RLVR 负责扩展可达推理轨迹，OPSD 负责降低已学会轨迹的生成成本。
summary.technical_approach: 论文围绕一个可检验假设设计实验：如果 OPSD 是 correction mechanism，那么在正确和错误 rollout 上训练都应提升准确率；如果它主要是 compression mechanism，那么只用正确 rollout 会保留准确率并缩短输出，而只用错误 rollout 会损害准确率。OPSD 的 teacher 是同参数 self-teacher，但带 privileged context。默认上下文是 Reflection from GT：模型先生成解题轨迹，再在看到标准答案后生成 reflection，teacher 在原问题和 reflection 条件下给出 token-level target distribution，student 学习匹配该分布。作者分别对 correct rollout group 和 incorrect rollout group 进行 OPSD，并进一步测试更丰富的 teacher context、中途重新注入反馈、增加训练步数等变体，排查是否只是实现细节限制了修正能力。
summary.experiments: 实验使用 7–8B thinking-enabled 数学推理模型，包含 Qwen3-8B、DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B，以及经过 GRPO/RLVR 的 AceReason-Nemotron-7B。训练 prompt 分布使用 DAPO-Math-17K。主要结果是：OPSD 作用在正确 rollout 上时，能够明显减少 response length，同时基本保留准确率；作用在错误 rollout 上时，准确率下降，说明 hindsight teacher 没有稳定给出可修复失败推理的 token-level 信号。更丰富的 privileged context、mid-trace feedback reinjection 和更长训练只是在准确率与长度之间移动权衡点，没有把 OPSD 变成可靠的错误轨迹修复方法。论文据此建议 SFT → RLVR → OPSD 的训练顺序，而不是用 OPSD 替代 RLVR。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 25–35 分钟。重点看实验设计部分如何拆分 correct 与 incorrect rollouts，这是论文最关键的因果隔离。其次看 Figure 1 和主实验表，关注 accuracy-length tradeoff，而不只看准确率。方法细节里建议看 Reflection from GT 的构造方式，因为 privileged context 的信息来源会影响结论外推。若关心 RLVR 训练后的推理成本，可以重点看 post-RL checkpoint 上 OPSD 的效果；若关心能力学习，则看 incorrect rollout 训练为何导致退化。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper examines why OPSD struggles to replace RLVR in thinking-enabled mathematical reasoning. Its main finding is that OPSD is more reliable at compressing already-correct long reasoning traces than at repairing failed ones.
summary_en.importance: The paper is not about pretraining directly, but it is useful for understanding the interface between foundation models and reasoning post-training. It clarifies a limitation of token-level hindsight supervision: in short outputs, the teacher may identify better alternative tokens, but in long reasoning traces it is much harder to specify the locally correct replacement for a failed global solution. As a result, OPSD is better viewed as a post-RL compaction stage rather than a mechanism for discovering new reasoning trajectories. This supports a practical training order: SFT for format and instruction behavior, RLVR for expanding reachable reasoning trajectories, and OPSD for reducing the token cost of trajectories the model can already execute.
summary_en.technical_approach: The experimental design tests a simple distinction. If OPSD acts as a correction mechanism, training on both correct and incorrect rollouts should improve accuracy. If it acts mainly as a compression mechanism, training on correct rollouts should shorten outputs while preserving accuracy, and training on incorrect rollouts should hurt. OPSD uses a self-teacher with the same parameters as the student but conditioned on privileged context. The default context is Reflection from GT: the model first generates a rollout, then sees the ground-truth answer and produces a reflection on its attempt. During OPSD, the teacher conditions on the original problem and this reflection to provide token-level target distributions. The paper then applies OPSD separately to correct and incorrect rollout groups, and tests whether richer teacher contexts, feedback reinjection in the middle of the trace, or longer training can turn OPSD into a reliable repair signal.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments use 7–8B thinking-enabled mathematical reasoning models, including Qwen3-8B, DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B, and AceReason-Nemotron-7B, where AceReason is a GRPO/RLVR-trained checkpoint based on the R1-Distill line. The on-policy prompt distribution is DAPO-Math-17K. The main result is consistent: applying OPSD to correct rollouts substantially reduces response length while largely preserving accuracy; applying it to incorrect rollouts damages accuracy. This indicates that the hindsight-conditioned teacher does not reliably provide token-level repairs for failed reasoning trajectories. Richer privileged context, mid-trace feedback reinjection, and longer optimization shift the accuracy-length tradeoff, but do not change this pattern. The paper therefore recommends OPSD after RLVR, not as a replacement for RLVR.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 25–35 minutes. The most important part is the split between correct and incorrect rollouts, because it isolates compression from correction. Then read Figure 1 and the main result tables with attention to the accuracy-length tradeoff, not accuracy alone. The construction of Reflection from GT is also worth checking, since the source of privileged information affects how far the conclusion generalizes. For inference-cost reduction, focus on the post-RL checkpoint results. For capability learning, focus on why training on incorrect rollouts degrades accuracy.

recommendation.zh: 建议看正确/错误 rollout 拆分实验；它提醒 OPSD 别当 RLVR 替代品，更像 post-RL 压缩阶段。
recommendation.en: Read the correct-vs-incorrect rollout split; it warns against treating OPSD as an RLVR substitute and frames it better as post-RL compaction.

paper.title: Power Distribution Bridges Sampling, Self-Reward RL, and Self-Distillation
paper.abstract: Recent analyses question whether reinforcement learning (RL) is responsible for strong reasoning in large language models (LLMs). At the same time, distillation and inference-time sampling, including power sampling, have emerged as effective ways to improve LLM performance. However, the relationship among RL, distillation, and sampling remains unclear. In this study, we focus on the power distribution, the target distribution of power sampling, and show that the power distribution bridges sampli

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文试图解释三类看似不同的 LLM 自提升机制之间的关系：推理时 power sampling、自奖励 KL 正则 RL、以及自蒸馏。核心问题是：如果模型性能提升来自把概率质量集中到原模型已经较支持的序列上，那么这些方法是否在优化同一个目标分布。
summary.importance: 它对理解 RL 后训练中的“能力从何而来”有启发。论文把 power distribution 放在中心位置，说明部分 RL、采样和蒸馏收益可以看成分布 sharpening，而不一定是引入了新的外部信息。这个视角对预训练研究有两个用处：一是帮助区分模型已有能力的再加权和真正的新知识注入；二是把昂贵的推理时采样转成离线训练目标，为自蒸馏和训练数据生成提供理论接口。
summary.technical_approach: 论文设定一个基础自回归模型 π，并定义 power distribution，形式上是对整条序列概率做幂变换后归一化，通常可写为 qα(y|x) ∝ π(y|x)^α。α 大于 1 时，分布会更偏向基础模型原本高概率的序列。论文先证明便宜的 token-level 局部近似很难复现 sequence-level power distribution，因为每一步 token 的正确再加权需要知道后续所有可能 suffix 的总贡献。随后从 RL 角度出发，考虑 KL 正则目标，其中 reward 是模型自己的 sequence-level log probability，即 r_self(x,y)=log π(y|x)。这个目标的闭式最优解正是某个 power distribution。再把这个目标改写成离线蒸馏形式，得到 power self-distillation：用 power distribution 作为 teacher，把推理时采样产生的分布形状摊销进学生模型参数。论文还给出 sharpening bound，并用 power distribution 下 true reward 与 self-reward 的协方差条件刻画何时这种 sharpening 会提升真实任务奖励。
summary.experiments: 这篇工作以理论分析为主。已给出的全文片段列出的主要结果是 Proposition 1、Proposition 2、Corollary 1、Proposition 3 和 Proposition 4，以及一个 power self-distillation 算法。没有看到大规模模型训练、参数量、数据规模或 benchmark 数值。可确认的结果包括：局部 token 近似无法在缺少 suffix 信息时匹配序列级 power distribution；KL 正则自奖励 RL 的闭式解等价于 power distribution；自蒸馏是否改善真实奖励取决于 true reward 与 log π 在 power 分布下的相关结构。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 30 分钟。先看 power distribution 的定义和 Figure 1，因为它连接了采样、RL 和蒸馏三种视角。然后看 Proposition 1/2，理解为什么不能简单用 token-level 温度或局部重标定替代序列级 power sampling。再看 Corollary 1，它是论文的核心连接：自奖励 KL-RL 的最优分布就是 power distribution。最后看 Proposition 4，重点是协方差条件；它提醒读者，sharpening 不保证提升真实能力，只有当模型自身概率与真实奖励对齐时才可能有收益。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether inference-time power sampling, self-reward KL-regularized RL, and self-distillation are different procedures for targeting the same distribution. The motivating question is whether some post-training gains come from sharpening the base model distribution rather than from adding new external information.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is conceptual and theoretical. It gives a precise bridge between sampling, RL, and distillation through the power distribution. For pretraining and post-training research, the useful implication is that a part of RL-style improvement may be understood as reweighting capabilities already present in the base model. It also gives a route for turning expensive inference-time sampling into an offline distillation target.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper defines a power distribution over full completions, typically of the form q_alpha(y|x) proportional to pi(y|x)^alpha. When alpha is greater than one, probability mass concentrates on sequences that the base model already assigns high likelihood. The first technical result shows that cheap token-level approximations cannot generally reproduce this sequence-level distribution unless they have information about possible suffixes. This is because the correct token-level marginal under the power distribution depends on the total powered probability of all continuations. The RL connection comes from a KL-regularized objective where the reward is the model’s own sequence log-likelihood, r_self(x,y)=log pi(y|x). The closed-form optimizer of this objective is exactly a power distribution. Rewriting the same objective yields power self-distillation, where a student amortizes the teacher distribution induced by power sampling. The paper further proves a sharpening guarantee and characterizes true-reward improvement through a covariance condition under the power distribution.
summary_en.experiments: The work appears mainly theoretical in the provided text.
